It is still dark when I wake up so I decided to grab a torch and go with her then which is usually around 05:30 - 06:00 am. As I walked along my local road which is a small road and very quiet, I noticed a red flashing light going across the sky which also changed to a yellow flashing light in quick succession. At first I thought that this was a plane going across and carried on but still glanced up at it as I walked. I soon noticed that this object, whatever it was, was flying in strange flight paths as it moved up and down and also went faster and slower, like it was hovering in the air. I was amazed to see this as I could hear no sound to prove that it could be a helicopter. I carried on focusing on it and as I had a torch with me, I pointed it towards this and flashed the torch by turning it on and off just out of curiosity. Suddenly the strange lights just dis-appeared on me. I carried on with the walk wondering to myself what it might be. As I had walked about a mile, I…

summary: Very large red orb, changing to green. Silent and hovering, then making unnatural maneuver.
description:
During the morning of November 25th 2011 at 4:55 am I witnessed a bright red orb in the northeastern sky. The object continued to hover in the same spot for some 12 minutes. It was unlike anything that I've ever witnessed and at one point changed to a very bright blue/green color. After realizing that this could not have been a helicopter because it made no sound whatsoever yet was within 1/2 a mile from my location, my concern prompted me to wake my roommate. We were both in amazement because again, we had both never seen this type of foreign abject before.
Quoting my roommate "I've been looking my whole life to spot a ufo and as much as I've wanted to see one, I can truly say that until this moment I never have" We both cannot believe that this object can in any way be of this world.
After observing for about 12 minutes the object suddenly moved vertically at a medium speed, then in a flash moved horizontally to the west and disappeared.

summary: Red/white/green flickering stationary triangular object over ocean  500 Lights On Object0: Yes
description: I and two others witnessed a flickering red/white/green stationary triangular object in the sky over the SE direction from Naguabo Puerto Rico towards St. Thomas. It's still currently in the sky. I have a compass reading & video shot on my iPhone.

summary: Three sets of three red-coral neon lights in line, "following" one another, from mainland crossing to Cozumel island, in México
description: 47 year old woman, mother of 3, Ive seen several strange things on the sky, nothing like this. Watching the starred sky, not a single cloud, I noticed what I thought was a shooting star. After longer observation I realized they were 9 lights, in 3 different lines. Three redish-coral neon lights in front row, three behind and three on the last line. I thought they were all togehter, like a long rectangular form, but then I noticed the three lights in the middle started to move from one side to the other, like if they wanted to outflank the one ahead of him, although it didnt. It went back to its original possition after a litte wiggling .They seem to aim for Cozumel which is the island in front of Playa del Carmen, where I live. I watched carefuly until I saw them dissapear behind the trees.

summary: 4 lights moving in a precise pattern as though on the perimeter of a sphere, following us for 15 mi.to our home
description: This happened last night (Thanksgiving) between 9:45 and 10:00 pm. We were traveling in our car south on Highway 99 from Fresno toward Visalia. There was a cloud cover and I looked out my right side window ( West) and noticed some dancing white lights. At first I thought it was a spot light being shown up into the sky, perhaps to attract people to a Black Friday shopping location. However, there weren't any stores near where this was occurring. I kept watching them while my husband was driving. The lights were moving in a very distinct and exact pattern. There were four of them. They were in a circle and they would rotate perfectly to the left about 90 degrees and then they all converged and meet as one in the middle of this circle. Then they would move back out to the perimeter of the circle, rotate to the left, then once again converge to the middle and start over again. I say circle because although I could not see anything but the lights, the pattern they moved in was a circle. Each of the 4 lights was the same size and they were softened by the cloud cover between the actual light and us. This changing of the pattern was constant and occurred several times each minute. It was…

summary: Oval shape craft with 2 extremely large bright pulsating lights.
description: On Thanksgiving night I observed a oval shape craft with extremely large lights, sort of like bugs eye on the side of the craft. Its lights changed from white to red mimicking a regular craft, although several other colors were also a factor such as amber, blue, burgandy, and green... The colors seem to Pulsate and move around the craft on a clockwise motion assuming there were identicle lights on the opposite side of what I witness. It made no noise and the only craft it could be compared to would be a blimp, but it was going extremely too rapidt. The light were larger that what I can make out of the craft. Traveled from east going westbound toward Streamwood until I lost sight of it.

summary: Round object rapidly changing colors with jets flying over it....video proof!!!!
description: Was the 2011 first shotgun deer season. Went outside at about 10 pm,the cabin where we are is far away from any big cities and looked at the horizon and saw a round flashing light in the sky. It was not there the night before or the next night. The object changed colors rapidly from pink, red, blue, purple, green and seemed to stay in one spot. I watched this object through binoculars and so did my dad and we could not figure out what it was. I took a video with my cell phone but it was pretty far away but you can see the object changing colors. I even have a jet flying over it in the night sky and the craft still did not move. Ive been going to this same location for 15 years and have never seen this before in my life, The craft stayed in the same place for about 45minutes then would shift position in the sky. I watched this object for well over an hour and it had no noise or any jet like features.

summary: Witnessed three bright orange lights in triangle formation that stood steady and unflickering approx.10 minutes then disapeared.
description: Witnessed three bright orange lights to the West of Madison that were in a perfect triangle formation. Lights were steady - unmoving and unflickering. Lights were visible for about 10 minutes then vanished.

summary: Formation of floating lights in Thanksgiving night sky
description:
This report is in response to your segment on Coast to Coast AM on Thanksgiving night concerning the red/orange lights in the sky.
On Thanksgiving night November 24, 2011 at around 2030-2045 I stepped outside my house to go to work as a night security guard. In the Eastern sky over Lathrop CA and headed toward Manteca CA the next city over, there were about 8-10 red lights in formation floating in the sky. It seemed that the lights were moving slowly West to East.
At first I tried to rationalize the lights as Asian Sky Lanterns but all of the lights moved in formation like a flock of birds and always maintained the same speed and interval.
My neighbor also saw the lights, though I cannot say that he was sober that night. Hopefully this report is part of a bigger puzzle from that night.

summary: I was driving home from Thanksgiving dinner at my friends house, about five minutes away.  It was a beautiful day and I had one heineken and one wine over the course of over six hours.  Plus all of…
UFO sighting in Raleigh/Knightdale on Thanksgiving
description: My boyfriend and I actually had 2 sightings on this evening. As we were driving towards Knightdale, in Raleigh, on Highway 64 business, we saw something shoot from the sky straight down and disappear. It had a glow to it as it shot down, and came down within a blink of an eye. Then, a little while later as we were standing in line on black Friday outside behind the best buy building, my boyfriend said, "Look." As I look up, and so did the other people in line behind and ahead of us, I saw two circular saucers flying in a staggered formation, one was slightly ahead of the other, across the skyline. It was almost like they were floating as they were moving, their movement was very fluid. Once we realized what they were, they were gone. They disappeared extremely fast. They looked like they were very dark gray or black with dull, glowing lights around the bottom. The other people in line also saw this, and were amazed. I know what I saw was not anything of this world.

summary: 3 strange lights with no object in sight but traveled from the north to the east disappearing!
description:
I was walking home from 7-11 in north park tonight and when I was on Arizona and University it was 8:29pm, I looked up in the sky & I saw 3 strange lights, yards apart. It was not any airplanes or helicopter There was no noise. The lights I saw were only a few yards apart about 50 yards approximately, they went only in one direction to the east but came from the north and then I hurried up the hill I was walking on because there were some trees in my way in view of the lights so when I got to the top of the hill I saw the last light drift off into the east but also disapperead and tonight is thanksgiving.The weather was clear no clouds, no rain nothing. 
I will admit I have never seen this before. The lights just disappearing into thin air.. I cant explain anymore.

summary: Two large Fireballs slowly moving south to north 11-24-11
description: We observed 2 rather large orange fireballs traveling south to north in the sky directly overhead. Moving slowly and looking like burning fireballs, growing brighter and dimmer and brighter as they traveled. Moving relatively slow, not like a meteor, too slow and yet faster then a air force jet. They did not seem to come towards the earth, but appeared to be passing by in space? One of our witnesses seen two more 20 mins later, same area and projection of travel.

summary: Orange spheres seen in the Albany County, NY area
description:
About 7 PM EST my mother said there goes the mail plane. I looked out to the southwest and there above the tree line was an orange ball just sitting there. I watched for a few minutes and thought why is it just sitting there and it didn’t look like any plane I had seen before. There was no sound like a plane. There was no sound at all.
I went out to the field that runs south along the side of the house so I could get a direct view of this object. Once out there a second one moved vertically up from behind the tree line. Now there are two of them sitting there. Then, they started moving horizontally slowly back and forth, but they were not doing this in tandem. They also moved slowly vertically, again not in tandem. 
After about 3 hours one moved to the north again vertically and vanished behind the wood line and the other in the same fashion followed.
I went back to the house but kept going outside looking up to see if whatever these were would show up and about fifteen minutes later I saw one coming directly overhead. This would be now moving in a western direction. It stopped over the house. It was now at a much higher elevation. I watched it for about fifteen minutes and then…

summary: triangular shape with orange lights moving slowly towards ocean, then disappearing.
description: under a clear sky, I looked up and saw two orange round non-blinking lights. One was behind the other a bit staggered and as I watched, the rear light turned towards the ocean. I continued to watch the other orange light moving slowly towards Charleston, and I noticed a triangular shape..the orange light on the front tip. It was flying extremely low, yet absolutely no sound, and the shape was very clear. As I watched for about another minute or so, the object veered towards the ocean as well. The orange light slowly began to dissipate and after ten seconds or so, it just disappeared completely out of sight. There were no clouds as far as I could see. It just disappeared. I looked up higher to see if I could see more, then saw the blinking lights of an airplane coming the opposite way where the object disappeared. Not five seconds later, I saw a beautiful shooting star!

summary: 3 stationary orange lights in a triangle just above horizon.
description: I had just got home to my apartment on Thanksgiving afternoon, around dusk, after spending it with a married couple friend of mine. I got out of my car in my apartment parking lot, looked toward the west and saw 3 glowing orange lights just above the horizon. The 3 lights made a vertical triangle. At first I thought they were 3 helicopters flying in formation moving across the sky but then realized they were not moving at all and were completely silent. Thinking logically, I then thought they were a radio tower but I knew of only one radio tower in the immediate vicinity about ¾ mile away and at that moment, it could be clearly seen 90 degrees to my right. I looked around the parking lot to see if anyone else saw the same thing I was seeing but I did not see anyone else. After about 5 minutes of staring at this thing, one by one, the orange lights just flickered off like 3 candles. I was looking towards the west during dusk so it could possibly be a sunset atmospheric phenomenon (I believe there was a high overcast cloudy sky that day). However, I had never seen anything like those 3 orange lights prior to, nor since, that day.

summary: Going from west to east over Saratoga High School 3-4 individual fireball type sighting moving across the sky.
description:
3 more in a triangle pattern lower in the sky.
No sound. I have video from phone cam

summary: Amber / Orange lights evenly spaced in a line moved north quickly and disappeared in the clouds
description:
My mother had just returned home and she burst into the house yelling, "Come outside and see the lights!" She sounded nervous and excited. She ran outside and pointed out 5 lights that were moving quickly north. My mom said that when she was driving, there were at least twice as many lights, arranged in two groups. One group was arrayed in a wedge shape, and the other was in a line. She had tried calling us on her cell phone, but she couldn’t find it in the car. She saw a man that had pulled over at a nearby intersection who had gotten out of his car to watch the lights.
The remaining lights were all in a north-south line, more or less evenly spaced. The lights were a strange amber / orange color, unlike any we had ever seen on an aircraft. The lights did not blink, they remained a constant glow. One by one the lights flew north rapidly and disappeared into cloud banks. We couldn’t hear any noise from the lights.
It was dark with a high cloud cover and intermittent showers

summary: Thanksgiving Evening shortly after dark, there was orange fireballs one after another, 7 in total, appearing mid skyline and traveling straight up into the sky until they disappeared into the…
Burning spheres over San Jose, California, and fighter jets after.
description:
Thanksgiving evening around 18:30 my cousin text me & says did you see that! Informs through text of a number of burning looking balloons and then fighter jets later. 
 Weird because last Thanksgiving 3 relatives a similar incident of witnessing something in the sky
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: Saw light move left to right, and descending
description:
My neighbor, my brother, and I all were outside my apartment having a smoke and walking the dogs. We looked west/southwest and saw a bright, hovering light. 
At first, I thought it was Jupiter or a possible helicopter, but I found Jupiter. I had the other two look at the light, just to see if they could figure it out-that's when we thought "UFO". I ran and grabbed my camera and got a couple minutes of it. I could see pulsating and the colors went from red to green to amber. We watched it until it dropped behind the building next door. It moved slowly left to right and descended. I looked at it with my Yukon Ranger night scope and it appeared to be just an orb of light that pulsated.

summary: ufo's in clounds around South mountian
description: I went out back and snap a picture of southmountian with my cell phone Thanksgiving evening. When i looked at the photo. I can see 2 small ufo's in center of clouds. One has three white lights in a triangle formation and the other is a solid white triangle. they are high in the clouds. Top of photo in the middle.

summary: What Did I Just See!  Waterbury CT. 11/24/11
description:
On Thanksgiving night I hear my father who went out on my deck for a cigarette screaming to come outside. 
As my wife, my father-in-law, and my mother and me run out we can see two bright orange lights hovering less than a mile from the house. My father who doesn’t believe in anything like UFOs starts to tell us that these two lights have been there for a while. 
Hearing my father explain this I can see he was very serious about these lights and I can hear the fear in his voice. The rest of us can’t believe what we are seeing and start to question if it’s a helicopter (nope they are to close together and there’s no sound), flares (it would of went out by now,) whatever explanations we are trying to come up with it is being tossed out the window. 
As we figure out what we are seeing the orange lights suddenly move to the right of us. They move simultaneously together gracefully through the sky, we try to follow them bobbin are heads trying to see through the trees when all of sudden the lights disappear. We all look at each other laughing trying to explain what we have just seen. 
A day goes by and I try to see if maybe the local news or news paper put something out there. Nothing…

summary: Witnesses said to my boyfriend that they saw an aurora-like blue-green light in the sky at or  before a huge power outage that knocked power out to the entire city of missoula for 1-3 minutes.  The…
description:
There were mixed reports of what caused the outage. The Missoulian reported that the National Weather Service reported that there where no clear or known reasons for the outage. 
Another report by local news KPAX reported that high gusting winds may have caused it. However, in Missoula winds were and still are 15 mph as reported by local hourly news on the radio. 
I called my mom and she got on the internet to check it out and at that time she read their was a local report that mentioned that witnessess saw blue-green lights in the sky. 
I could not find that stated when I searched later but did see that all local reports via internet had been revised from their original ! report. Possibly excluding the witness reports of the lights? I think so. 
I have lived in missoula 22 years and Ive never seen an outage taking the whole city. As soon as it happened I felt like sometihng was wrong. 
So did my sister across town and because so many people were talking about it at the gas station where my boyfriend was working at the time of the event, he too said he "felt something was up"

summary: Round object that emited light, or reflected sunlight onto ground by the camera, 1 hour after sunrise
description:
The UFO sighting was on Thanksgiving Day 11-24-11. The location is 4 miles south of Shell Lake, Wisconsin. It was photographed with a Moultrie trail camera that uses motion to trigger the shutter.
The camera was on a tripod 3 feet off the ground facing southeast tilted up a little bit.
The weather was clear and the first picture was at 8:01 AM central time, which was about 1 hour after sunrise. 10 pictures were taken with varying times between pictures from 1 minute to 13 minutes, indicating the object stayed in one position and didn't trigger the motion trip on the camera.
The object was round in most pictures, The object cast a light or reflection off itself on the ground by the camera. It was yellowish to white. There was only one object. It vanished as quickly as it appeared, not moving out of the cameras motion detector a little at a time.

summary: White light becomes two and changes colors
description:
Two different object that remained stationary in the sky and after 45 minutes they are still in the same location. It appears as one white light and then two white lights beside each other. 
Then it appears as is multiple small lights changing colors: red, green and then white blue and back to light. 
It almost appeared as a triangle at certain time- but more like the lights made the patters of lights in streams of lights.

summary: A single spot light shinning on me from on High above.
description: I was sitting outdoors smoking a cigarette in my folding chair, it looked to me to be clear skies. When I looked up toward the northwest sky and I saw one bright head light (like a car head light) shining from high above towards me. I thought it might a an airplane but I heard no jet noise. Then the light slowly turn away from me then continuing on its course flying very high from the northwest towards the north at about 35,000 feet then the single light was turned off, I quickly got up to see if there was any other sort of lights on the craft but saw none and the craft seem to have disappeared I could not see it or its lights.

summary: second sighting.
description:
First on Cape Cod, Second in Boston
very clear ball of light. Was not too high up nor close enough to touch any building. The object flew from my right to left fast enough to not be identified as a plane.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: V Shaped low Flying Aircraft with many Red and Green Bright Lights fly 20 ft over my car.
description:
I was driving home in the suburbs of Laguna Hills, Ca on a usually busy street, but not at 12.am. I make a left from my current street and head my ascent up a large winding quarter mile hill. As I put my foot on the gas I notice an object over head, pretty high in the sky, about 50 degrees up from my horizon. This object was red on one side and green on the other, but from a far away distance it just looked like a red and green small blob moving across the sky in a sweeping flying motion. As I neared the middle of the distance of the long street, the flying object went out of view and basically just disappeared. I don’t know of many helicopters or planes that visible or low at midnight but ill just pass it off as a normal sight.
I just ignored the sighting until all of a sudden at least 20 feet above my car there was a huge v like aircraft. This aircraft was about 10 ft long side to side and had a series of about 20 large square lights from side to side on the front of the V which was facing me. The lights on one side were green and the other 10 or so extremely bright lights were red on the other side. Once I saw this I swear my stomach dropped and I floored my car. All I knew was…

summary: Huge flash diamond in the sky.
description:
I was in the street with 3 other people when I was looking to the sky I saw a diamond like star unusually close to the sky then a huge flash and then It left extremely fast as if it had shot something and when I came back inside my feet had been bleeding.
Source of report indicates that the date of the sighting is approximate. We do not understand why. PD

summary: Small white flashing lights all over sky and bigger round non flashing object traveling low above womans car seen on Sherman Pass, WA.
description:
I was traveling from Colville, Washington, to Republic on Sherman pass. I came over the top of the pass and noticed a flashing white light. I thought that it was an airplane at first. 
As I came down the mountian further there is quite a big area where you can see very far, and all around. I was looking an noticed that there was not just one white light but many lights flashing randomly in the sky around a large object that had many colored lights. The bigger object was not flashing and moving verry slow and low. I realized that it was not an airplane as it got closer. 
I was driving in my car the whole time I was watching. The closer it came to me i could tell that it was round. it had red yellow, blue, etc., lights in a circle pattern seeming to be the bottom. It also had a few lights shining out the sides. It flew verry slow and seemed to be traveling twords my car. It came very close crossing right above my car. 
It was big as far as i could tell, as it was verry low and traveling slow. I think it may have been changing colors and the pattern on the bottom was changing a little i cant be sure. I was very scared and after i had passed the area I didnt really look back. 
I was…

summary: V shaped, silent fast moving orb formation.
description:
Appeared to be a "string" of perfectly, evenly spaced round shapes in a triangle formation. Moving quickly and silently North to South. 
No lights, but the shapes were illuminated by the light pollution from the ground. Around the same distance from the ground as the small personal aircraft I see flying around here from the local small airport. 
I have never seen anything like this in my almost 49 years on Earth!

summary: Large White Fireball disappears behind Estrella mountains
description:
I was sitting on my balcony tonight, talking on the phone when I noticed a large white ball type of light that appeared closer than the planes flying towards Skyharbor airport. There are a lot of stars out tonight, but this was closer. The light caught my eye because of its size and it was pulsating, then out of nowhere, it fell straight down until it disappeared behind the Estrella mountain range. 
When it was falling it looked like a white fireball with a fat white tail, not that of a shooting star that arcs with a thin tail.

summary: Four orange orbs sighted in New Hampshire
description: We saw four orange orbs in a square pattern in the sky while driving down the road. As we approached them the bottom right orb of the square took off quickly and disappeared into the distance. Then one at a time each orb followed the last one until all four were gone.

summary: Upside down "Y" low flying overhead wiht 4-5 dimly lit amber lights on each leg
description:
steeping off my back porch to enter my vehicle with my wife i noticed a a aircraft flying from north to south over my house it had to be flying low from the angle and distance and size it passed coming in to vision and leaving the vision of the sky i had visible i live in a city so i had limited view of the sky after pointing out what i seen to my wife "do you see that" pointing to the sky i was dumbfounded it made no noise and was traveling at a decent speed hard to Jude speed of objects in air of size reference and distance away.... i also shined a green laser pointer at it that i happen to have in my pocket nothing happened. the aircraft outline was not visible but a row of dim amber lights that looked like an upside Y was visible no sounds were made there were about 4-5 lights per leg of the "Y" and the lower leg was leading. like below | | | | / \ / \ / \ / \

sorry about that, it was in the afternoon 8:05 pm it was a very interesting event. even tho it didn't last long it has made an lasting impression on me.

We have amended the time above, to reflect an evening sighting. PD

summary: Four faint, moving lights and one chevron-shaped object seen in Scarborough, Canada
description:
Between 7pm and 7:45pm Toronto time, my brother, my sister, a family friend and myself witnessed four objects in the night sky over Scarborough Ontario.
The first object was shaped like an upside down V, had three lights and was the brightest. The other three objects were very faint, however we could tell that the colour of these objects alternated between white, orange and red.
All four objects were observed to hover for periods of time, then move vertically back and forth, then horizontally, then in circular motions. One object we observed shot across the sky from one location to another at a speed that seemed almost effortless.
One object, a bright ball, appeared and sped across the sky, then disappeared. It was bright white.
We returned indoors after we witnessed this activity. I returned outside, but I could not locate the objects.
I would be most interested to have corroboration of this sighting from other people in the Toronto area. As the lights were very faint and, by appearance, very high, I would suspect other people in the region of south-western Ontario may have also seen them.

summary: Large Floating Diamond Shaped Object Seen Floating 50 feet above neighbors house
description:
This event occurred in 2011, November 23rd around 7:15pm (Salinas, CA.) It was already dark.
I had just parked and exited my car and was walking towards my house when I looked across our residential street.
There, floating about 50 feet or so above a neighbor’s house, was a large, diamond shaped object with a horizontal line through the middle and lights in at least two of the corners.
It appeared to be about the size of a standard two car garage or maybe larger, it was hard to tell. It was space grey in color, self illuminated and made no sound whatsoever. I stared at it for about 5-10 seconds or even more trying to understand what it was. I next decided to try and get back in my car to see if I could get closer to it and see it from another angle, so I tried driving around the block but the object was gone. That was the end of the encounter.
NOTE: I am open to being contacted by NUFORC if further information is needed

summary: black diamond on video in broad daylight
description: I captured a diamond shaped object on video in broad daylight. The object was black then copper colored then faded out then black again. It repeated this pattern 4-5 times. It would remain each color for about 2 mins.

summary: Silver/white orbs seen over Belton, MO
description:
At approximately 12:45 pm on Wednesday, November 23rd, I saw a line of 8-10 white/silverish orbs moving in the sky from the northeast to the southwest. If I held a quarter at arm's length, they would have been about that size. 
I first thought it was a string of balloons floating but there was no line apparent between them and they were moving against the wind. 
Their height and speed did not change while visible. They were at a height such that they would have had to be extremely large balloons if that is what they were. 
They moved in a line except at one point where they formed a cluster and then moved back out into a line. 
I looked down to get my phone to take a picture, and when I looked up again they were in a cluster, then one in the cluster began to move away and they formed a line again. 
They were visible for about a minute to a minute and a half and then seemingly disappeared. I was not able to get a picture. The camera would not focus on them aga! inst the blue sky.

summary: exceptionally bright lights turned night time to day time for 4 min
description: saw exceptionqlly bright light outside my bedroom window, it was not cars passing by or airplant passing through. it was like day time outside that I could see my mailbox number. then the light went to the woods ahead, there was nothing on the sky at all when I looked. it was not lightling and has no noise. I stayed by the window for at least three min, then saw the light outside starting to change color from little green to little red. I mean the sky was so bright i thought it was day time already. I could not figure out what type of light actually does such good job from the distants. it turned the night sky into day time and I could not tell where was the light coming from except the woods.

summary: This incident took place on 11-23-11, I had just passed Alaska Regional Hospital and was heading West on Debarr Rd. and had just crossed Lake Otis, where Debarr turns into 15Th. Ave.  It was around…
description:
The day was very sunny with low hanging scattered clouds. I had been looking Northwest at the low hanging clouds over Merrill Field Airport (Small Aircraft Airport and turned my gaze to my left, which is Southwest, and said out loud to myself "what is that" and there at the end of a low hanging cloud was a round silver metallic object hanging motionless. 
I live near this area and I'm familiar with all of the small aircraft and helicopters that land at Merrill field. And this object was like nothing I had ever seen and was completely still. This part of 15th is very busy so I went up the hill and made the first left to see if I could get a view looking East, no sign of the object,I drove around for quite awhile and it was gone.

summary: White orb of light visible from I70 somewhere between 2-91 and Lees Summit rd. moving to the east.
description:
I was driving west-bound on I-70, between 2-91 hwy and lees summit rd exit i noticed an "orb" moving slowly my direction. It passed over me about the time i reached the offramp and had to get out for a better look! 
So i jump out of the car and this object seems to stop moving, im just standing there almost right underneath it and i just cant figure out what it is. 
Ive seen quite a few helicopters at night in this area but it didnt have any of the same lights the others have had, and no blade noise ! 
I have to add that i felt so drawn to this object i pulled my car over on the side of the hiway at almost 2 am. . . and after i did the object stopped for almost 5 mins and i swear it felt like it was watching me back!
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides little contact information. PD

location: Geoje Island (South Korea), CA, South Korea
summary: 2 Fireballs Blaze through sky simultaneously
description:
Opened a window in Apartments to have a smoke, And look at stars usually while smoking noticed 2 fireballs Traveling at Enormous speed, Came from right side of my view and preceded together at constant speed and constant distance to each other till they have became really small and finally disappeared in a horizon. 
Judging by the size in comparison to stars it was just as big as Northern Star but Very bright red color, was not flashing or leaving any tails, was not emitting any sounds i stayed to listen for engine roar hoping it was a plane. 
Couldn't be a plane, it was not up for long enough to clear my whole range of view of the forest that is stretching out about 20km 10mil aprox. from my apartments.
Don't think it was a comment or meteorite, they never left a tail, nor did they disappear in mid sky, they covered All of the sky in less then 5 seconds.
Im Sorry i couldn't take picture or video because it just happened instantly, and caught me by surprise and stunned me for a little while.

summary: EXPLAINED: Bright lights in Somerset county NJ on 11/23/11
description:
Reports on this website dated 11/23/11 that describe brights lights in the middle of the night that quite literally turned day into night, and changed colors including yellow, green, blue and red can all be attributed to a transformer explosion that occured on that evening. It was also followed by a power outage that struck several hundred homes in Somerset county.
My wife, our 10 year old daughter and myself all witnessed this event and while we joked about "the aliens landing" we can assure you that this was a terrestrial event related to the weather at the time (it was raining very hard with strong wind) that damaged a nearby power transformer.
Here is a link to an article on the incident - 
http://www.nj.com/news/index.ssf/2011/11/bright_flashes_of_light_widesp.html
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

These orbs have reappeared recently again in the sky as I have had one sighting of them 1/13/2017 often after or during the sightings a low flying military plane would come overhead. We have no big airports or military bases for miles.

summary: A bright, blue light instantly shot to the right, and then decelerated.
description:
On the night of November 18, 2011 a friend and I were travelling home from a dinner in Niles, Ohio, to my house in Newton Falls, Ohio. Traveling at 55 MPH on Ohio State Route 5, heading West-South West my friend saw a bright blue light, approximately the size of very bright star or small planet. The object had a light blue color to it and was very bright. 
I looked at the object, which was stationary, for about 4-5 seconds. Just then, the object made a sharp, fast movement to the right of viewing traveling about three or four inches in my scale of the sky view. It then rapidly decelerated, and continued to travel, this time at a slower pace, to the right where it disappeared behind the clouds. The light had an approximate height of 45 degrees from the ground. 
 Visibility shaken, we both asked each other if we saw what we thought we saw. We continued along the highway, but were not again able to identify the object. When we returned home, we immediately turned to the internet in an attempt to see if anyone else had seen the object.
I do not believe that the object was either a helicopter or plane, due to its stationary state then instant acceleration to the right followed by rapid…

Had wings, but more squared-shape,mostly black all over, with orange or red lines denoting the sections from underneath. 
Saw it while turning into a drive that led to a parking lot. Once we looked back, it had disappeared. And, what was striking, it had been moving slowly, and lower than an airplane would fly, especially in that area. My friend and I compared notes on what we saw; was unable to get a photo, but definitely was not a notable object to this area.

summary: I saw a glowing, boomerang/sickle shaped object in the sky over Brandon
description: I was standing outside on my back porch walking my dog, it was about 12:30am. The sky was clear when suddenly an object appeared. I thought it was a shooting star at first, but it vanished and then reappeared. There was not tail, or trail of any kind, no visible propulsion system and the object was silent. It was smaller than a full moon and the shape was sort of like a boomerang, but with a point coming out the back in the middle. It was NOT “V” shaped, or triangular, or chevron shaped, it was rounded on the front, almost like a sickle blade, not pointed. The whole object was glowing an almost orange-cream color. It was moving incredibly fast, I only saw it for MAYBE 5 seconds, and in that time it shot across the sky and I lost it as it went over my roof. If I point to where I first saw it and where I lost it, my arms are at about a 110 degree angle. It was definitely not an air plane or helicopter, there were no flashing lights on it and it was moving! way too fast. Its presence didn't seem to have any effect on my dog, I don't think he even noticed it, but I have never seen anything like it before. I called the local Air force base to see if they were running any training…

summary: Dark triangular wing in night sky
description:
On the evening of Nov. 11, 2011, I was walking my dog at 22:00. The night sky was clear, there were no clouds and the temperature was in the low 30’s F. There was moderate ambient light from the streetlights and neighborhood homes.
 While gazing at the night sky I noticed an irregularity of movement in the sky overhead. I could not focus on it at first when it was directly overhead but as it moved away from me, I started to discern a shape to the form. It was triangular with truncated tips. The leading two edges of the form had what appeared to be a series of round soft edge openings that where slightly lighter than the main body of the object. There were approx. 12 of these. Their outline was not hard but was soft edged and appeared to be in motion. The object itself was as black as the night sky. There were no running lights thhat would normally be associated with an aircraft. There were no other discernable features only the silhouette of shape with the leading edge feature.
The object made no noise and it moved from the northwest to the southeast. I would guesstimate it’s altitude to be approx two to three thousand feet. The span of the object was significant along the…

summary: 2 eyewitnesses see 3 reddish glowing lights in a perfect triangle formation silently hovering 200' above ground.
description:
A friend and I were driving to the corner store and noticed 3 reddish glowing lights in a perfect triangle formation. They were approximately 500 to 600 square feet in size and were silently hovering just above the tree tops (cottonwood trees approximately 100 feet tall) on the west side of NE 29th Avenue as we were driving southbound, right before coming to the stop sign on NE 29th Avenue at NE 219th Street. 
 We had drove by it very slowly looking up towards it on the west side of NE 29th Ave and then continued on to the store, but in the short time of no more than 7 - 8 minutes they were gone when we drove back by the place we had just seen it. 
We scanned the sky as we continued home a few blocks down from where we had seen it on NE 29th Avenue, but now we didn't see anything. It was totally gone or was it just out of our eyesight? Where did it go in such a short time? 
Oh and did I mention that there was not any engine type of sounds, that it was completely! silent when we first saw it and slowly drove past it with our pick up windows down.

summary: Sighting near Colorado Springs. Black triangles above the road.
description:
I was on my way home from a buddy's house when two perfectly triangulated craft were flying directly over the road in front of me. They were both heading east over highway 24 towards the prairies. they were only about 500 feet high and were the size of about a 5 bedroom house. They were exactly identical. They both had a red, green, and yellow light at each corner. The only difference is the one on the right had a white blinking light at the front and a red blinking light at the rear. That did not blink with a rhythm like our aircraft.
I saw them perfectly clear. They were so black on the bottom, that they blacked out the light of the stars above them. They were about 40 ft. apart from each other and never shifted from their flight path or elevation. I also heard zero noise when they flew over me.
This is the second sighting I have witnessed in the last few months, and it is Awesome!
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: 16 ors along with firealls light up Indiana sky

My mom, sister, girlfriend, and I quickly went outside where we witnessed 16 orb shapes blinking different colors and what appeared to be within the middle of them fireballs falling from the sky. The fireballs looked similar to a flame thrower and a large rumble could be heard when they were seen. The fireballs lasted for about five minutes from when I witnessed the event and the orbs remained for another 15 minutes afterward before they slowly moved away in all directions. During this time, our cell phones, internet, and cameras could not picture anything.

summary: Triangular shaped. 2 white lights & 1 red light. Low & slow flying, silent.
description:
Last night on November 17th, 2011 at approximately 6:45 pm I went outside to get something out of my vehicle. As I was walking back up the steps to the door I noticed a strange light in the East/Southeast. At first it didn’t appear to be moving but seemed too bright to be a star. I stood and watched and about 10 seconds later it started moving towards my house.
As it got closer I noticed it was triangular in shape and had two white lights and one red light on it. The lights were very bright. It was flying extremely slow and at very low altitude, however I couldn’t hear it. I continued to watch and it flew directly over me. It probably took 3 minutes from the first I saw it until it disappeared over the tree tops.

summary: Shiny Object Morphs into M Shaped Lights then Vanishes
description: While walking to my car after work approx 6:45 pm, I witnessed what I at first thought to be baloons floating by. I could only see the shiny reflection of them as it was dark out already. It was just above the powerlines from my perspective, so not very high in the sky. As I watched, it "floated" by in a very fast, steady & straight direction. If it were baloons, it should be gaining altitute but it just kept going straight from west to east. There was no sound whatsoever. As I continued to watch, it looked as if it tilted onto it's side and morphed into several lights in the shape of an M, then vanished. I have no clue what it was, but it definately was not baloons. As soon as it vanished, there were several planes much higher above flying around close together.

I continued on the side road around the second bend; it remained hovering in place to my right , no more than 2 to 3 blocks over from where we were. There was no sound. I slowed the car down. I told my daughter to get out the phone to take a picture but she said "No, this is freaking me out!" I stopped the car and switched gears to reverse. At this time the three lights faded into six small bright lights, still in the same triangular shape and it headed north very slowly among the treeline.
I dropped my daughter off at her friend's house (she ran in and yelling me she would call me in a bit). I could still vaguely see the lights as I backed out of the driveway, among the trees. summary: Strange disc of light with trails of orange/pink on either side sighted above mountains.
description:
Driving along Highway 7 South I spotted an unusual object in the sky. It appeared to be a glowing disk shape in the sky. On either side were two trails of orange/pinkish light, trailing down. At first it looked very much like a shuttle launch or something similar, except that the shape that the trails of orange/pinkish light were coming from an object that didn't really look like any craft I've seen.
Then I wondered if some kind of large balloon may have been set aflame (it's far fetched, but that might have explained the weirdness of the thing). he problem now, as I pulled over to check, was that it didn't move. It was almost a fixed point. I stayed there for 10 minutes or so before I left, simply because I was busy and hoped I could capture it from my home, only 3 minutes away.
Unfortunately, living amongst the mountains made it impossible to see the object as it was now blocked by a nearby mountain.
 Also of note is the fact that it did not make any sound.
 I don't know if it were a craft, but it's certainly a phenomenon unknown to me.

The upper layer of lights extended past the edge of the bottom one, which appeared more rounded than rectangular. I watched the craft leaving no contrail, and then, suddenly, jolting to a stop, it begin to move forward in waves, like it was being tossed in the wind. Upon chasing after it, I lost sight of the object and have not relocated it.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: Orange sphere trailing high flying jet
description:
Location; N 32 33 36.54 W 93 34 28.26 Objects direction of travel was approximately 280 to 110 or WNW to ESE Estimated elevation of jet aircraft and UFO: 35k-40k I had stepped outside with my dogs when I observed a high flying jet aircraft about 10 degrees north of vertical from me. My first thought was that there was an orbiting satellite above him, but then the ball maintained a steady distance behind the aircraft and was on the exact same flight path. Also, a satellite in low orbit should have been out out of the sunlight by the time is was directly overhead and this object never lost any of its brilliance even after passing out of sight to the east. It also appeared to maintain its spacing behind the aircraft.
Saturn had been recently very prominent in our sky but was much smaller than this object and the color was much different. Saturn was bright and obviously a star or planet. The object trailing the aircraft was orange and appeared as though lit from inside.
My background: 20 years USAF Electronic Countermeasures…

I was able to record a few seconds before the UFOs disappeared from view. As I got off of my car and ran to my grandfather to tell him more appeared. I did not record those and I feel incredibly stupid for not doing so but I was so excited as I saw more slowly appear in the sky as they came from the ground. There were about 9 in total.
As I was speaking to my grandfather while standing outside I observed that the lights would turn off after about 20 seconds. Interestingly, the objects were still visible after the lights turned off and maintained the same altitude as they continued South. After about the 9th object, they stopped appearing.
Video was uploaded onto youtube for ease of viewing.

We were facing south and right above the tree line in the sky I saw two reddish orange disc shaped balls of light. They did not appear to be moving, but they slowly faded out. 
So we stood there to watch, and they reappeared, but in a different spot just a little to the west of the first sighting. The sky was clear so the weird thing is between the first and second sighting we herd a thunder like sound. The lights faded and reappeared about 3 times within about 10 minutes. That was the first time in my life I ever seen anything like that. It was amazing!

summary: Small, faintly triangular light seen over east Norman, OK
description: At approx. 0100 UTC, I sighted a small triangular light streaking overhead at estimated altitude of 10000 feet above MSL, accurate to within 5000 feet. I had heard a helicopter in the distance and dogs in the yard barking about 30 seconds prior and stepped outside to observe. The helicopter was fairly low, about 500 feet or less AGL. It appeared to be on the same heading as the object and appeared to be in pursuit. I spend a good portion of my time observing and studying aircraft, and what I saw was quite obviously no aircraft. It was completely silent and appeared to be traveling at 800+ knots. It, along with the helicopter appeared to be on a heading of about 180 magnetic. I believe that this was a UFO because of the incredible speed and the lack of navigation lights or sound that would accompany an aircraft.

It passed over north of Cedar City, UT after dark and streched from the north east all the way across the sky to the north west moving slowly in that direction.
I was in a quiet location and could not hear any noise.
After the event I called a friend on the local Police Dept. who said he also witnessed the event and he said there was lots of calls into dispatch reporting the event.

summary: White blinking lights in the sky above Monument Valley, Utah.
description:

Multiple flashing white lights in a sequential pattern. Students closer to sighting could hear and sense a pulsation like a drum beat. Others has car alarms go off and photos came out black. Some cameras and phones would not work. Image is now found on Facebook.

summary: Half mile long string of blinking lights that we observed for 40 minutes

We were traveling on Highway 89 towards Kanab and lost site of the lights at about Big Water. The lights were traveling Northwest. They did not rise or fall in elevation or change in distance between the individual lights. We stopped the car at one point and could here no noise. The lights were white, but I would say that at times there was an amber cast to some of them. We started out watching them at 6pm on November 16, 2011 and followed them(traveled in the same general direction with them) for 40 minutes. We finally lost them at Big Water.

I parked the truck and ran to the outer edge of the woods to the west and could not see anything. Whatever it was must have headed north or northeast. It was like a string of old fashioned white Christmas lights. The string was in a east/west pattern traveling north.

The object/row of lights appeared to be positioned over the abandoned farm area near the next curve. I cannot believe the people in the house on the corner did not notice it. There are only about 4 homes in that area of the marsh.
I saw a row of…

summary: Over a rural road, six horizontal lights appeared low in the sky for a few seconds and disappeared, silently.
description:
My husband and I were driving on County GG near Coloma, Wisconsin and at approximately 5:50 PM we saw 6 horizontal, evenly spaced lights appear in the sky. They appeared low in the sky and reminded us of stadium lights but in a horizontal pattern as I described. 
We both asked, "What is that?" and they immediately went dark. Within seconds, we stopped the car, turned off the engine and got out to listen. There was no sound. We expected a plane, helicopter or something, but it was silent.
This is a rural, county road. There are no trees, etc. or other visual obstructions where we were. The only other traffic was a truck 1/4 mile ahead of us that appeared oblivous to this. There are no towers, city lights or nearby airport.
My husband and I have lived in this area for 30 years. We are both retired teachers. I am 51 and my husband is 62 and have never seen anything like this. This is the first time I have ever reported something like this.

summary: UFO lights near Kayenta, AZ
description:
On Wednesday, November 16th, 2011, at approximately 5:40p m in the town of Kayenta, Arizona 3 of my children and I were playing basketball outside on the drive way when we saw strange blinking lights in the Eastern sky from our position. The temperature on that evening was about 40 degrees, not much of a breeze, no moon to show for, and the sun was about to set over the mesa in the west.

In November of 2011, My helper and I (who work for a construction company) were approaching the Narrows bridge in gig harbor,WA, at approximatly 5:30 p.m when my helper noticed something in the sky. I looked up and saw a circular shape object that appeared to have a glow around it. Almost like a white/yellowish haze. We both were stunned.I remember my hair standing up on my arms. 
 As we were looking at the object it went out of our site around some trees, and just a few seconds later we came around to see the other side of the trees in our truck and didn't see anything. I want to mention that this object was not real high in the atmosphere. Not sure what it was but the glow around it really amazed me. Never seen anything like it again,nor will I or my helper ever forget it.
Witness indicates that the date is approximate. PD

summary: California Fireball Western Sky November 10, 2011
description:
My two daughters and I were outside, after sunset, the sky still light blue with a marine layer. My 7 year old said "mom look is that a rocket"? 
I went over and looked in the Western sky toward Lake Elsinore area, and there was a huge fireball with a fire-trail behind it, which then exploded into four big pieces which then had fire-trails behind them, we ran and just saw them disappear between the trees. 
I have never seen one so big and close as these were.

summary: A huge craft flew over my building at close range so that I could view underbelly.
description: I heard a sound coming like a plane, but lighter rumbling. I was on second floor, looked out and up my window. I saw the underbelly of a flying craft that covered the complete view above me. I saw two distinct round red lights adjacent to each side underneath. I followed flying object as it went over the pacific. It seemed either round or oval shaped, not sure. I saw big red and white lights blinking. The entire view was huge compared to the normal plane lights I usually see. The under belly was metalic, minus the big red lights. But it was hard to make out everything under there as it was such a surprise to me to be experiencing this.

summary: Triangular U.F.O. hovers near a main road, then over a neighborhood.
description: As I was on my way home from a 24hour gym, I approached an intersection by my house to see the two people in the car perpendicular to me were pointing at something out of their car window. I look up to what they are pointing at and I see, what appears to be a triangle shaped object with white lights on each vertex. In the center of the triangle three red alternating lights were blinking. As the craft moved, it made no sound, so I immediately ruled out it was a helicopter or a small aircraft. As it descended closer to the tree line, it reflected the light of a street lamp and the shape was different than from when I initially saw it. The craft almost resembled a triangular boomerang. Then it moved over the trees and disappeared into thin air. Thinking I was crazy and sleep deprived, I drove on and continued into my neighborhood. Nonetheless, I look up out of my driver’s side window and I see the lights of the craft right above the tree line. I slow down my car and roll down my window to double check if it was a helicopter. The craft the completely silent also seemed to "hover" and slow down when I did. I turned a corner and it followed me briefly for approximately 50 yards. That’s…

summary: Disk shaped object emitting lights in eastern direction.
description:
Disk shaped. Row of windows across lower edge. Lights emitting alternating white, blue, and red. 10 degrees above horizon in eastern direction. Can clearly see with binoculars.
Sirius, located below Orion. PD

summary: Strange Lights Above Hobart
description:
I was driving southbound on Highway 18 just past Hobart when I stopped to pick up gas around 10:30 PM. It was cloudy and had just stopped raining. I noticed two very yellow lights perhaps 3/4 of the way up the sky to the northwest. These lights were almost a lemon yellow. Very peculiar and odd looking.
I stood there looking at them while my tank was filling up when they started moving apart. First one started moving to the Northeast. A second or two later the other started moving West.
The one moving Northeast continued down to about halfway up the sky when it rapidly vanished. I'm not sure if it went into the clouds or just turned off. It didn't jut blink off but faded out over about 1/2 second. The one moving West disappeared behind the gas station and I lost sight of it.
I would guess the whole episode lasted about 15-20 seconds but I wasn't checking my watch so I can't be sure. I wasn't frightened. Just transfixed and curious.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: Hover craft pointing green laser into the sky
description:
The first thing I noticed was a green laser (like a high powered green science lab laser). Seemingly pointing to a craft. 
Grabbed the binoculars a saw a craft with red and blue lights, almost like an airplane but it wasn't moving and I couldn't hear any sounds. Also noticed that the laser was comming from the craft extending 2-3 degrees into the sky pointing at an angle of about 300 degrees (or at about 10 o'clock) Went to get my camera flashed a picture (which didn't turn out because the flash was on and it was dark out) when I looked back up it was gone!

summary: Round metallic jellyfish-like craft with white blinking lights flies over car low & slow, Columbia, SC
description: I was driving West on Rt. I-26 and was near exit 104 (Piney Grove) when I saw what I thought was a low flying plane headed East, almost directly over the road but slightly South of the road. It was dark outside and the craft had several white lights (4?) underneath that blinked on and off about every 1 or 1.5 seconds. It was flying very low and slow and as it approached and flew overhead I looked up twice and saw that it was circular in shape. I thought perhaps it was foggy outside and that the glow from the lights made the craft appear circular (it had been very foggy on a prior night, but it actually was clear this night). I am not sure if it generated any sound as I had the radio on, but certainly there was no loud engine sound. I wanted to turn around to follow the craft, but I had just passed an exit. I thought it had the shape of a sort of metallic jellyfish but without any tendrils. I could not locate any media accounts of this sighting, so maybe i! t was a plane after all.

summary: Large greenish glowing light moving very fast.
description:
Was on bicycle heading west. After turning right I notice a large greenish glowing light heading very fast eastbound. The object appeared about half the size of the full moon was traveling many times faster then any aircraft I’ve ever seen. The shape of the object appeared to be a sphere or ellipsoid. The altitude is unknown. 
The object was first observed at about 50° above the horizon and escaped from view in about three seconds. Object almost appeared to be falling from the sky. The area has too much light pollution to observe any meteorites (though this object was way too massive to be a meteorite anyway).

summary: A fireball over Olympia, WA on 11/9/11.
description: A fireball with a long tail appeared over the Olympia, WA area heading east to west at a very high speed.

summary: A triangular shaped object this a white light at each vertex and a red light in the center.
description:
On November 9th 2011, my brother and I ware driving down 80th Avenue going to our local church for a confirmation meeting at about 6:40pm. My brother was driving. He looked to his left and said, "What’s with the lights?"
I didn’t see them at the time because of the roof of the car. I thought it was a plane or a street light or something.
Then we pull up to the next intersection and he points it out again. This time I see a vertical line of four lights. One was red. We turn onto the street where the church is off of and we get a better look at it and notice that it’s triangular shaped. And the red light was in the middle. And we also notice that it’s spinning slowly and moving. We were basically following it though the parking lot of the church until we parked at one end of the parking lot. The object was spinning slowly as it moved across the sky at about 30 or 40 mph.
We get out of the car and watch it continue moving in the same direction (East) until it was too far away to see. We also notice, after getting out of the car, that it was completely silent. It was probably the most extraordinary things I have ever seen.

summary: Two bright orbs dropped from the sky and glided  incredibly fast across the entire sky, going south over Oregon.
description:
My daughter and I fell asleep watching a movie. I woke up briefly and looked for the remote to turn off the DVD player. I tightened the blanket around my daughter and laid back down on the couch in the living room where I stayed to sleep next to her. I laid there trying to fall back asleep and I noticed a VERY bright light drop strait down from far up in the sky. There was no sound but as I sat up to look my daughter woke up and turned to see what I was looking at. 
The orb or disk of bright light then soared almost glided across the entire sky VERY fast, amazingly fast. My daughter turned to look at me and I at her and another light shown through the window. This bright light dropped from the sky in the same place but not as high as the first one, stopped and as fast as the other one, glided across the entire sky in the same direction. 
There was never any sound. I told my daughter I'd look into it in the morning and laid there awake till morning.

summary: A bright white pulsating, top shaped object with intermittent red, green, blue, purple lights with a small tail.
description:
Last night a friend and I noticed a very bright, top shaped light appear south east of Morganton, N.C.. The object barely moved with no sound, and flashed red, blue, and white intermittent light. 
After 10 minutes another object appeared 1 mile northeast of the other with the same features. 
I went home and got my wife out of bed to observe them, while my friend called his cousin outside to witness the objects. We live 7 miles apart and stayed in touch by text messaging. 
I viewed the first one with binoculars and it seemed to pulsate and had a tail similar to a comet, but had very intense streaks of red, green, blue, and purple light while the main body stayed very bright white. 
The moon and was in 3/4 stage far to the west of the objects. We did witness man made aircraft passing under the first object. The aircraft was dwarfed by the object we saw. I could not see the second light from my house because of trees, but my friend, 7 miles north west could see both. 
In 47 years, I have never saw anything like it. I witnessed the "Halle-Bopp" comet in 1997 but these objects seemed much closer to the earth. 
A few days ago I learned the local news reported a UFO sighting over Lake…

summary: Flashing red, blue lights around stationary object with white lights: seen Nov, 5, 6, & 8 in western sky of Maine.
description:
My wife and I witnessed an object on Nov. 8, 2011, in the western sky that appeared to be stationary. It glowed and had flashing red and blue lights that flashed (or strobe) around the object in a CCW manner. White lights were also around the object, but these didn‘t seem to be flashing.
The object could have been cylindrical in shape but could have been V-shaped. This object was not a plane or helicopter as it did not appear to move much as witnessed to be in the same general location several hours later. Possibly the rotation of the earth could make it appear to move slowly down in the western sky as time passed.
We originally thought it may be the ISS or a satellite but this appeared to be larger and/or closer to us. This object was also seen for several nights before we both saw it. What is this??
Twinkling star?? PD

summary: Bright object fell from sky for 2-3 seconds, disappeared for 1 sec, then reappeared and fell 2-3 more sec.
description:
I am a 44 year old wife and mother. I work in the public school system, and I was getting in to our family van to go into town for groceries... When all of a sudden I saw a light object, toward the North, coming straight down (it looked sort of like a falling star) and after 2 to 3 seconds, it completely disappeared. 
Then, one second later it reappeared closer to the ground, for another 2 to 3 seconds. Then it disappeared completely. 
It was extremely brilliant, and seemed closer that the typical shooting star. 
WOW, it was amazing!!! 
It happened at exactly 7:00 pm EST (I looked at my watch immediately, and it had only been dark for a short time outside, and was still super bright. 
Thank you! 
My daughter was with me when it happened, and she was turned away from it, so did not see it. However, she can certainly back up my excitement and rambling on and on about what I had just seen, and what she had just missed.

summary: We were traveling North West on Hwy 70 from Lordsburg, NM, to Duncan, AZ, when my boyfriend and I both noticed a bright orange light in the sky over Safford, AZ if I had to guess.

Finally they all disappeared all at once. They stayed stationary the whole time and were too big to be planes. All were orange and the same size. The sky was really clear in the direction of the lights.

summary: Three Objects in differant parts of the sky,  All changing color and two that moved around.
description:

One was not moving and in the northern sky, a second was in the SSE sky and went from be still to moving erratically very fast and moving in a straight line. The third object was in the SSW sky and was still and then started moving erratically very fast then moved off. 
All three objects had lights that changed colors, The colors that I remember were blue, red, green and white.
Twinkling stars? PD

summary: Moon disappears for 4 minutes at 4:40 p.m. on 11/8/11
description: Just before event, I was on my back porch with binoculars viewing the full moon hanging low in the Eastern sky. I turned to the west to view the sunset for a minute and when I turned back around the moon was gone. The sky was clear - save for a few wispy clouds. I was equally astonished to notice that the time was 4:40, and the date was 11-8-11, also significant as these are Cardinal numbers. And it wasn't until 4:44 that I was able to identify the moon again. The only explanation I can think of is that the "asteroid" blocked the moon from view. Four years ago on 4/15 at 10:10 I filmed a waxing crescent moon which became partially obscured by a cigar shaped shadow (vertical) which began its trajectory in the center and moved up at an angle, exiting the tip of the north side of the waxing crescent. George Noory reported that a small asteroid was a "near miss." Shortly thereafter NASA reported they were no longer allowing astronomers and universities to view incoming photographs from their satellite images simultaneously upon arrival. I hope this information has been useful.

summary: Lights on & then shot straight across the sky at a slight downward angle & then gone w/ no fading of the light, within seconds, if that
description:
I live out in the country about 5 miles from a smaller town. Where I live the homes are mostly acreage with a mountain here and there. The closest mountain to me is about 5 to 7 miles away.
I have a very clear section where I stand out on my porch at night and can see a large area of the night sky.
The night that this took place the sky was clear, no rain or clouds, at approximately midnight.
From out of no where I saw a bright light very high in the sky come shooting almost straight across at a very slight downward angle and then it just was gone. This occurred in a matter of seconds, if that. There was no fading of the light as it went by and no fading as it got out of distance.
I would set the scenario like this; lights on and then lights off, poof, just on and then gone. There was absolutely no sound from it at any point. In all my years I have never seen something like this before.
There was no shape of the object other than a light. From memory, I have to lean toward a white light but I cannot be sure. It may have been yellow, but the color would be no other color other than white or yellow. Like said though, from memory I aim towards a white light.
I am able to write this…

summary: V shaped object, or grouping of objects, flying low - completely silent - no lights.
description:
Monday, November 7, 2011 at approximately 11:00 or 11:30 PM I was out in the yard walking my puppy when I saw a shadow on the ground. The dog saw it too and we both looked up to see a very large object, or group of objects, overhead. It was very similar to a flock of geese, but the V was inverted as it was moving forward, and one leg of the V was curved. 
It felt to be fairly low in the sky. I could see individual darker objects, evenly spaced, which made up the V or were positioned along the perimeter and no lights. 
There were no wings flapping or noise, and if it had been geese the size of the dark objects would have allowed me to see necks and wings. It was moving very quickly overhead. 
It disappeared before you would have reasonably expected to no longer be able to see it. 
It was a very unusual sighting, unlike anything I have ever seen before.

summary: pulsating orange lights in a triangle formation
description:
Around 7 pm est I saw three burnt orange lights in a triangle formation moving south above the tree line parallel to my home. I live beside a 50+ acre field with great visibility and a perfect view of the night sky. 
At first I thought I was seeing maybe car or truck brake lights on my property so I walked to the edge of the field to check it out and quickly realized it was something flying. The lights seemed to be pulsating on and off about every two seconds. 
I cant say how far away it was, but I heard no plane or helicopter sounds. Sounds crazy but thats what I saw.

summary: Black disc, Unidentified Flying Object just south of San Antonio, Tx
description:
Pleasanton,Tx. 5:30pm: I was sitting outside, on the phone in my backyard. It was a breezy afternoon...The sky was a beautiful pink and as I was enjoying the view, I noticed in the distance coming from the southeast, what I believed was a balloon someone let go. I even called out to my son to look at the balloon! But then I thought it was too high. 
As I continued to watch it, I realized it was not at all a balloon as it never weaved. It was a simple black, what appeared flat looking circle. Seemed to travel as fast as a jet may. There were no lights or ridges on it. It was like seeing a black polkadot cross the sky above me. It disappeared heading northwest. I was so mesmerized by it that I did not dare run in to get a camera, I was afraid to lose track of it. I wish I would have.

summary: Two white lights above Leland (NC) moving towards Carolina Beach
description: Two oblong, hazy-white, illuminated objects, one slightly higher than the other, tracking southeast across the night sky, less than a quarter mile from my home. Appeared to be approximately 500 feet in the air, separated by about 50 to 75 feet, moving slowly for first 15 seconds, then speeding off faster behind the tree line. No sounds of jet or prop engine noise despite being so close to my location. I immediately turned on the police scanner to determine if there were any aircraft over the town or on approach to the local airport (Wilmington International). No aircraft traffic reported inbound, outbound or in the greater Wilmington (NC) area at the time. Verified the radio traffic at the airport with a call to another amateur radio operator and also confirmed with the airport's arrival/departures website.

description:
On 11/06/2011 at 23:40 I heard a strange noise that caught my attention from outside. It sounded like a vuvuzela.  At first I thought it was an airplane, but I noticed it wasn’t moving. I watched the craft for 15 minutes and I got up so I could write down what I saw. I was not exactly sure what I was looking at. When I returned and looked back out of my window the object was gone. I was certain at that point that I just witnessed a U.F.O. and needed to report it immediately.
Thank you for your time and I hope this helps someone

summary: Looked identical to a star, but it moved like crazy, and NOT a shooting star.
description: Me and my sister saw two disc, i say disc for lack of a better word, that looked EXACTLY like a star to the naked eye. They both were hovering in practically broad daylight when we first saw them. We could not understand why no one else could not see them, because even though they looked like stars to the naked eye, they were both moving, or hovering in the air. Fast forward to 11 p.m. that night, and we were outside of my house, and sure enough, we caught a glimpse of apparently the same craft, but this time it was just one. I swear that it looked just like a start moving, and I brought out my telescope and looked and looked and looked trying to see if I could make out anything besides a bright star looking object that was hovering. I could not, and slowly from the north east it hovered until right over the mountain range by my house, and slowly hovered down disappearing from sight down into the mountain range. Scared us to death. Hope someone else saw this! same phenomenon last night. This is NOT A FAKE SIGHTING. ill put my reputation on it.

summary: Soundless white light moving horizontally just above tree line
description:
I was sitting on my front porch, looking out due west at the clear, starry sky. Straight ahead, I noticed a white light moving horizontally, from west to north, just above the tree line. I thought it odd that it was so low and close, yet I heard no noise. 
My view was partially blocked by a few leafless trees, so I could not be sure if the light was steady or blinking. It moved with a steady velocity, neither slowing nor speeding up.
It was moving towards dense forest, and would soon be blocked from my vision, so I walked down my driveway to observe for as long as possible. I watched it until I could no longer see it. 
Oddly enough, I did also see a shooting star just west of the light, while i was standing in my driveway. This was an interesting comparison to me, because what I'm reporting was definitely not a meteor.
I do live about 30 miles from an airport which use to be the site of an air force base and also about 10 miles from a smaller airport. I have seen every sort of aircraft imaginable, but nothing like this.
I do not consider myself a UFO buff, nor am I the type to seek out sightings or contact. I felt the need to report this because it was so odd, low, close and…

summary: Orange flame looking object observed over Greer SC
description:
My wife and I saw what looked like an orange flame moving slowly above our house. It was not round, but oblong with points at two ends at times. 
The shape and size changed slowly, like a flame growing and shrinking. It was much bigger than a star, but not as big as the moon, maybe 10 to 15% as big as the moon. It was not distinct but seemed to come in and out of focus. 
We could not gauge the altitude. It moved from in front of the house to over the house and seemed to pause, then moved back to the front again. Our house faces south east. 
When I went in the house to get a camera, my wife said it seemed to shrink away to nothing before I came back. 
She said it looked like the flame went out, not like it climbed in altitude.
I am a 63 year old engineer with a large international company. My wife is 60 and works as an event organizer/fund raiser for a non-profit agency.

summary: 5-7 pulsating amber-orange orbs observed slowly moving below the clouds from west to east above Portland, OR.
description:

The speed was low (<100km/h). They were below the clouds, which were mid-level. 
They were about 20 degrees above the horizon, and the estimated distance was 3-4 miles. 
The observer was a PhD scientist, who also had orb sightings in Fairbanks, AK in winter 98/99 and winter 00/01.

summary: My husband, mother-in-law and I were on our back deck and saw the red lights just above the tall trees in our backyard, they were not fast moving, just going along at a medium pace, they were not in…
description:

My husband and I are in our late 60's and his mother is 90, we are retired and enjoy a quiet lifestyle in Tennessee. This is the first time any of us has seen anything unusual like this in the sky. 
I called the local sheriff's department right after we saw these lights and reported what we had seen. 
We called the small local airport on Monday and they did not even have anyone at the airport Sunday night and knew nothing about the lights. 
We would love to know what these lights were and if anyone else saw them.
