My brother said they could have been Chinese lanterns, but seeing how fast these orange balls were going, each following the same direction and path, and moving at various speeds...we counted the Chinese lantern idea out. The objects were orange in color, round in shape, looked like balls of fire gliding through the sky. 
 After seeing about 3 more sets of the orange…

summary: July 4th, 2011 over Northboro, Massachusetts, eight adults see a large, orange fireball hovering.
description:
My husband, daughters and I were leaving a friends’ house and as we came out the door of the house and stood on the driveway a few of us quickly noticed a glowing orange "fire" ball in the sky. The eight of us range in age from 55-18 years old.
At first we wondered if it was a plane in trouble (on fire?). But then, it seemed to be getting closer to us and my husband said it must be a hot air balloon and we were just seeing the glow of the fire in it. It was a dark night.
We were looking towards the southeast and the fireball was traveling from north to south. Next we wondered if it was a satellite, but it was traveling too slow and at times it just hovered and didn't move. That was the strangest thing of all. It was traveling in a linear path and didn’t change altitude. The altitude was hard to judge since we didn’t know what we were looking at, but it was at probably the upper limit of what a hot air balloon would travel at.
After four minutes of discussing this on the driveway, we all agreed that we had no idea what it was. We were all feeling unsettled, even my sensible engineer husband. Then, in about 10-15 seconds flat it flew up and away from us into the darkness. We watched…

summary: REDDISH -  ORANGE anomoly appears in the sky about 25 degrees above horizon, moves, changes course, drifts overhead as if observing .
description:
We (5 of us in our driveway - and about 15 people in the driveway across the street) were right in the middle of lighting fireworks. Of course there were sky rockets and mortars going off all over the place, HOWEVER. 
At about 10:45 pm a fairly bright (3 on a scale of 5) Orange Reddish light (which appeared to be pulsating slightly) SUDDENLY APPEARED IN THE SKY AT ABOUT 25 DEGREES ABOVE THE HORIZON, It came from the direction that dozens of small, medium, and very large Aircraft per hour do on approach to the BOISE Airport. BUT LANDING LIGHTS ARE WHITE, THIS WAS A BRILLIANT REDDISH ORANGE. out of the NNE and headed slowly and silently to the SSW and then CHANGED COURSE to a more due S direction. 
It was hard to determine the altitude. IT WAS DEFINITELY NOT ANY KIND OF FIREWORKS, HELICOPTER, AIRCRAFT, there were no strobing running lights at all. IT COULD HAVE BEEN A SATELLITE AS THE SUN HAD JUST DROPPED BELOW THE HORIZON ABOUT AN HOUR AGO. BUT IT WAS TOO BRIGHT AND SEEMED MUCH CLOSER. It could have been a chinese lattern that some Yahoo let loose. HOWEVER - IT JUST APPEARED IN THE SKY ALL OF A SUDDEN - NO CLOUDS. 
My step daughter tried to get a video on her phone but couldnt…

summary: 20-25 Orange Lights move from West to East and then disappear.
description:
Approximately 20-25 Orange Lights in sky moved from West to East for approximately 5 minutes in a missile like formation and then changed shape. 
One light came from North West after all others had moved to the East and then another came from South West. 
All then disappeared.

summary: big circular object in the sky
description:
we thought first its a plane,the sky that night was soo clear.
we all talking, then i looked up again, the object that was burning, it was far high, stopped from being on fire and still moving, i was telling my friends look up again, at the same time it gained speed,then that object turned and start coming down no sound at all, its looked like when a plane is trying to land.
when it came closer i looked closely to it, and it was in a shape of circle and big.
it looked to me that it was trying to land somewhere, 
my first encounter with such thing, i know that it wasnt amediar or aplane, it had no flashing lights at all it was circular shape.

summary: Orbs sighted in mountains east Ogden
description:
Sighted large blue orbs, one was stationary another was accelerating downward as if falling down the mountain at a very quick pace. I would suggest that the object was moving a few hundred yards in just seconds. 
Also spotted an orange light near stationary orb. Stationary object suddenly moved briskly in direction opposite of previously mentioned "falling orb", the two orbs quickly moved toward each other then all three lights vanished. 
Sighted about 10 minutes before lights vanished. Objects were to high into the mountains to caused by human activates and were too close to the mountains to be aircraft. Very strange how two orbs were so close together then appeared to be one half of a mile apart within such a small time frame. 
I have experienced this type of sighting more than one time. 
My only possible explanation would be extraterestial or paranormal.

summary: Three lights in line formation.  Disappeared in about 1 minute
description:
My wife and some friends were standing in an open lot behind a plywood factory watching the 4th of July celebration. 
During the event we noticed three small, bright lights appeared northeast of our position. The three lights appeared to be several miles away judging by the distortions or twinkle of the lights and appeared to be orange to almost red in color. Initially, I believed them to be some sort of aircraft in a line formation as the judged altitude was about 3000-4000 ft with motion and speed consistent with an aircraft.
As I watched, I realized the lighting was inconsistent with any aircraft beacons or navigational lighting. The light emitted was a constant reddish-orange.
The objects appeared to be traveling in a southwest direction towards us. As they neared, all three objects gradually faded, sequentially disappeared one after the other. 
Nothing unusual was further seen afterwords. 
Weather conditions at the time were very clear with a slight breeze from the southwest.
I am convinced this was something very out of the ordinary as I have very extensive knowledge of aircraft patterns in the area and am very familiar with civilian and military aircraft types. I do not…

summary: SAINT JOSEPH
description:
Driving home from Kansas City about 5 minutes from home we saw the first object just hovering over a neighborhood. Very different from the fireworks going on tonight. A steady orange color about 5 or 6ft in diameter given the altitude of about 500ft. I was visible for several minutes as we passed on the highway. Once home we saw 5 more orange lights appear in the eastern sky one after the other and pass over our house, in a extremely straight line and very fast moving west toward Rosecrans airport/139th Airwing base. 
Three directly east and two from the Northeast toward the same westerly point. As they passed over our house you could clearly see the underside was not illuminated with the same orange color and it appeared to be a reflective disc object at least a 1,000 feet up. There was no sound, no blinking lights. Once they passed over they were no longer visible. 
Myself, my husband and three children witnessed this event. In the distance you could see an airplane with its blinking lights. This was very visible and very unusual.
We have amended the time above to reflect an evening sighting. PD

summary: One bright red light, not flashing, traveled from north to south about 1,000 ft above us.
description:
It was the night of the 4th of July, 2011 in Newport, Oregon, along the Central Oregon Coast. My friends and I were on my boat, moored at the marina, watching the fireworks display over Yaquina Bay. The display ended around 10:30 pm. I noticed a bright, solitary red light in the sky to the north. It was traveling north to south, directly towards us, and I believed it to be an airplane; except the light was not flashing, and was much larger than lights on a plane.
 I watched the light for about a minute, waiting to see flashing or other colors with it. But there were no other lights or colors. I pointed it out to one of my friends who had remained after the fireworks display.
 He and I watched this bright red light coming in our direction for about two minutes, trying to determine what it might be. We considered it was probably a light from a Coast Guard helicopter. That wasn’t the case. Within about four minutes of first noticing the light, it was finally directly overhead, at an altitude of about 1,000 feet. We then knew it was not an airplane, or a helicopter. It made no sound whatsoever. It appeared to be traveling faster than any plane that would have been flying overhead.…

summary: Yellow spheres over Ogallala
description:
My husband and I were sitting on our deck watching the fire off their fireworks tonight and the first sphere we saw we thought was part of the fireworks but we noticed it never burned out or fell to the ground but stayed in the sky and traveled east to west in the southern sky. 
About one to two minutes later we spotted another sphere traveling in the same direction at the same altitude and speed. We followed it as far as we could but them lost it in the tree line. 
They were both yellow speres, no sound, and traveled at the speed of a small plane. 
We live close to the airport and we know the what small planes coming in to land look like and these we not planes. 
They were very bright, no flashing lights, just a yellow spheres. 
We have seen these before but have never seen them flying so low or so slow.

summary: My wife, myself and some friends were coming into our town when witnessed what I wanted to call a Chinese lantern.  It flew right over the car.
description:
I got a decent look at it from underneath and it was not flickering at all. The color was almost like a day glow/florescent red and the color moved like smoke within the red. 
We circled the block to get another look at it but by the time we got there,
 it was gone. It is my opinion that what we saw on the night of July 4th, was moving at a moderate speed and not at a floating speed such as what a Chinese lantern would exhibit.

summary: Ball of fire floating over Forks, WA during the 4th of July fireworks display
description:
We were watching the fireworks display in Forks, when I noticed a small gold/orange ball of light approaching in the distance between two large trees. I pointed it out to the others with me and we watched and listened assuming it was a small plane but there was no noise. 
As it got closer the shape remained the same but the light it emitted was flickering as if it was made of fire. 
For a while it looked like it was floating but it slowly made its way from North to South. 
When it was almost directly over our car the light began to get dim and it went out. When the light was out I could still barely make out the shape of the craft and it seemed to be grey in color. 
It then veered quickly East and seemed to disappear.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: I was sitting in my backyard facing north at about 22:45 hours on July 4th, 2011.
description:
In the sky to the north of where I was sitting, a large orange spherical shaped object was travelling very slowly from east to west. It did not appear to be burning or fiery, just a glowing orange color. 
My family has a history in avionics (my father flew a B-17G in WWII and I flew cargo with him for years after the war) and, from my own personal experience, I would have to estimate the size at about 75-100 feet in diameter, about 1,000 feet up in the air and travelling at about 2-3 knots. 
The object travelled about 75-100 yards at this speed then immediately ascended in a northerly direction at a highly accelerated rate. It did not "bank" like you would expect from an aircraft, it immediately switched directions. 
I could not detect any sound coming from the object or its flight. 
I watched it travel in this direction until it was out of my line of sight.
We spoke via telephone with this witness on three occasions, and we consider him to be an exceptional witness. He has flown aircraft, since boyhood, and he reports that he has never in the past been witness to a UFO. We suspect that his report is exceptionally accurate, and reliable. PD

summary: It looked like a flaming ball of fire moving at  fast rate of speed from the South to the North.
description:
The first time we saw the sphere it was approximately 10:30 PM. My neighbor saw the orange fiery sphere in the sky from the back yard. He told us all to look and pointed at it. 
It looked like it had a trail of fire moving underneath it and behind it a little too. It was a pretty good size sphere and was moving at a high rate of speed from the South to North. We all ran from the back yard to the front to follow it and then it stopped in the same place for about one minute then it just disappeared.
At about 11:00 PM my boyfriend and I were outside in the front yard and we spotted the sphere in the same place that it disappeared. 
We tried to get a video of it with our phones but we could not pick up the sphere quick enough. This time the orange sphere was staying in the same place but only stayed glowing for about 30-45 seconds.
Then the third sighting was about 11:15 PM. I was standing alone on the back porch letting the dogs out to go to the bathroom and I saw the orange sphere again moving at a steady fast pace from South to North I ran from the back of the house and out the front door and by the time I got there I saw it disappear in the trees.

summary: 10 witnessess saw a redish orange glowing silent object starting in the south hemisphere and dissappearing 3-4 min later in the north
description:
There was 1 redish orange glowing object. It didn't flash like a plane it glowed redish orange and made no noise at all and went in any path it chose. sometimes in circles as this picture attests. 
My wife attempted to photograph it coming at us but the camera wouldn’t focus. This picture captured it's behavior going away from us . . . . the tree is not moving but the object is going in what ever direction it wishes as it headed north! 
The color never faded until it disappeared in the distance. It started in the southern hemisphere and after about 2-4 minutes disappear to the North.

summary: Orange balls of light,  Not lights on object, object was light. will be back July 4th.
description:
They are orange balls of light that show up every year, July 3rd but always July 4th.
Here in Warrensburg Missouri on Montserrat Road that turns into Division Road about 10:30pm to 11:00pm. 2011 they went from east to west, but 2012 they went from south to north. I call them fallen angels, I go an yell at them and tell them they will be cast in hell someday. This last time the one ball of light I seen was by Montserrat Mo. The moon this time was in the east, but the time before 2011 it was setting in the west. It almost seem that those balls of orange light were going straight at the moon. I would say they were less then 20 feet high over my head, and no bigger then a softball. On July 3rd. 2011 there were two balls of light, but these were yellow with a red ring around them. The yellow and red ones pass by my house two times My wife seen the first one then later another one went by that My wife boy neighbor and I all seen.

summary: Unidentified, slow-moving glowing object, Sylvan Grove, Kansas
description:
Observed unidentified flying object passing north over Sylvan Grove and slowly moving east to west---no sound. 
Thought it could be an airplane, but there was no sound to be heard. 
Distance to object was hard to discern. 
Went inside to get camera but no more objects appeared. 
All 3 people in the party thought it was strange. 
Unidentified.

summary: Bright red orb seen on July 4th
description:
My wife and were sitting on my front deck watching fireworks. I was looking to the north and I saw a red orb at first I thought it was fireworks but the red orb continued to head in our direction. The orb flew over head with no sound and it appeared to have a rotating red light. 
Then approx. 25 min. later in the eastern sky we saw the same type of orb but this one kept appearing and disappearing eventually disappearing all together. 
I was hesitant at first to write this down, but I saw that more people saw the same type of orb all over the country.

summary: Four round, lit craft flyhing in a low, v formation over Elk Grove, Ca.
description:
I am a 59 year old IT specialist. I have never seen and reported a UFO before. This is the 4th of July. 
The fireworks ended about 9:50 PM (and were a long way away and not visible at all where we were due to the height of the houses and the distance to the fireworks (2 to 3 miles). 
At 10:25 PM, I was in the pool with my girlfriend and I was looking up at the sky saying how great it is in California to see meteorite showers and other such things in the night sky because the sky is always clear in the summer in California (as opposed to Illinois where I lived all my life (58 years) until this past October). 
Just after I stated how clear it was and almost "on cue", four round, glowing objects came into my line of sight out of the southwest, heading northeast. They seemed fairly small, and flying fairly low; similar to the altitude of a single engine plane flying low. They almost looked like four searchlights shining on a thin cloud, but the stars were out, and there was not a cloud in the sky. They were fairly dim, but brighter in the center, and rimmed with a soft glow around each. They were in a "v" formation, but there were three on the right, with one on the left. I am aware…

summary: Yellow/orange ball of ligt with NO sound.
description:
I was not alone in seeing this, my 2 kids and a friend all saw it.
it was a bright yellow/orange light moving south west to north east. I first saw it while driving about a block from my house in sheboygan falls. the size of it didnt seem to make sense as it seemed quite large.
I quickly pulled into my driveway and got out in time to see it passing overhead; there was abolutely no sound. I was really pretty astonished at what we were seeing and not hearing any sound at all.
I have seen from time to time airplanes with landing lights on, but that was not what this was.
The light color and intensity was the same going away from us as it was as it approached, as well as when it passed drirectly over us I know that often times these things are explainable, but this was very unusual.
Infact as we stood there trying to figure out what we had seen, we could see and hear a prop plane at a higher altitude heading straight south, it was very obvious what that was. I am convinced what we saw was something very unusual.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: One ship disk shape with symmetrical lights around it zoomed through sky in a and then disappeared.
description:
Laying down on my car i witnessed a UFO sighting. 
The UFO was a disk shape barely visible, except for the lights surrounding it in a perfectly symmetrical fashion. 
UFO came from an eastern direction traveling towards a western direction it traveled 3/4ths of the sky then vanished, took only 4-7 seconds to travel distance. 
It traveled faster the any plane have ever seen and left no trail behind it.

summary: Slow moving fireball in sky
description:
Fireball appeared to hover in the east and slowly tracked west for about 2 minutes. 
No sound and it certainly was not a plane or some sort of firework. 
I have never seen anything like it before. 
The fireball was white/orange.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: Orange object approximate 2 minute sighting.
description:
On the evening of July 4th, my son and I were in the backyard, as he was letting off some fireworks. I was sitting in a chair facing north a few feet from where he was at. I was watching the fireworks that he let off, as well as some others in the neighborhood. I was looking east up in the sky. I saw a small light, thinking it was the remains of someone's fireworks. 
As I kept watching, it moved and got bigger. It was heading SW in the sky and was orange in color. It appeared to be oval shaped but looked like there was a smaller area on the top also orange. The light was solid and did not blink. Due to all the fireworks around us, it was noisy, but in moments of silence I could not hear any noise coming from the object. 
I kept watching until my view was obstructed by a tree, that was close by. I jumped up to see if I could still see, it but it was gone. It either disappeared, or went behind the tree where I could not see it any more. 
My son saw it also, but was intent on his fireworks, so did not pay much attention.

summary: orange firey object floating in night sky!
description:
On july 4, 2011 approximatley 22:15, I was walk down the street and i seen an object in the sky i believe it to be a ufo.
It looked like a big ball of fire, about half the size of a baby, small but large to see something like i did in this night sky. The object moved towards me from a far distantance, it made sort of a circular motion and they back and forth very fast, it had made like a high pitch screeching sound.
I then grabed my phone to take a picture, the picture on my phone did not look like what i seen in the sky when i took the picture, thats what got to me, it then stood there like something was watching me for about 3 mins, and then quickly went away it just vanished into the east sky.
i then called authority to seek answers they told me i was crazy, i personally dont belive i am, and knowone belived me, and that scares me! 
I as a U.S. citizen personally did not belive in these type of things untill i came face to face i am petrified, worried , and i need answers, is it what i thik it was? 
What did i see was it a ufo, it was fourth of july could it have been fire works? I dont know, but it didnt look noramal to me!!

summary: Bright orange fast mover.
description:
This event happened July 4th, 2011, after sunset. Although, I’m unsure of the exact time, it was around 10:15 PM CDT. There was still plenty of light in the North Dakota evening sky. The sky was still blue and there was some scattered stratus clouds at an estimated 20,000-25,000 feet to my SE. The clouds were normal white with grey shadowed areas. The visibility was unlimited. The temperature was around 75 F and the wind was light. 
I hold a commercial pilots license and a BA. My state of mind was good; I was alert, well rested and completely sober. I was wearing my glasses which bring my vision to 20/15 – 20/10. I have a small loss of hearing at 50Hz left ear.
I was standing on my driveway looking to the north at a few fireworks going off in the valley. I noticed a reddish/orange glowing orb appearing to rise into the sky at about the same area of the fireworks. At first I thought it was part of the display and continued to watch expecting a firework burst. The object continued in my direction getting brighter and moving horizontal rather than vertical. It had been coming from the same direction as Minot Air Force Base. I concluded that it was traveling from the horizon rather…

summary: 6 sightings of red-orange crafts over Billings, MT, July 4th, 2011, 10pm to 11pm.
description:
On the evening of July the 4th, approx. 10:15 PM. Over the Yellowstone River. 
Myself and my wife both observed from our home red-orange crafts appear in the far southwest sky, and slowly move and hover over Castle Rock Park during the fire works show. There were at least 6 separate crafts that would appear and move slowly, then disappear at the cloud to the north-northwest, and almost instantly reappear to the south west again and again.
This event lasted til 11pm.
I cannot explain what it was, but it was not fireworks or any aircraft I have ever seen. Its movement was smooth and deliberate, 1 craft hovered for 15 minutes before heading into the cloud, which was the only cloud in the sky that night.

summary: yellow or orange lights east bound on I-70 over wheeling wv.
description: driving home saw 6 lights in the sky east bound on I-70 around 2210 hours on july 04 2011 the color were yellow or orange and disappered one by one they did not display any shapes but did apper to be moving.

summary: Unusual pulsating ball of light.
description: After watching fireworks for the evening, I was headed home along Interstate 70 Eastbound. Just before reaching the Smithton Truckstop, I saw what I first thought was a plane on fire, in the sky, left of the Interstate, headed West. The object in question did not seem to have any blinking or standard aircraft lights, but had a pulsating fire looking light, which did not turn completely off at any point. The object seemed to be traveling at a consistent speed, like a normal aircraft, but the light is what made it unusual. I was unable to safely pull over and observe it, as construction work is in progress along that section.

summary: red lights in the sky on the 4th of july
description:
On the 4th of July 2011 at 10:00pm. 
My mother, father, myself and my husband were on my back porch watching fireworks displays in the sky. When we noticed two red lights in the sky they were redish orange and round in shape. We thought were chopers in the sky.. they moved slowly across the sky and then disapeared. They were extremly high up. 
We dismissed it and continued to watch the fireworks displays when we started seeing more red flying lights appearing. Someone at that time, then others in what seemed like formation. 
They were not fireworks as they were exteremly high up and seemed to be moving like aircraft would move. They moved in what seems like formation then they would disapear. This happened over a period of time.. for about 20 mins. I would like to know what these were... as they were very strange to see.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: Circular shaped craft, luminous and silent  with a halo type glow around it flew directly overhead.
description:
On July 4th 2011 my wife and I were parked on the north end of Berryville, Ar. Watching the fire works being shot off of Saunders Heights. 
At 10:45 P.M., we noticed a very bright multiple colored light to the south of us over Berryville, Arkansas. We thought it was fire works but it did not disappear, but kept silently moving towards us, maintaining its altitude. As it passed over head with out making any sound you could see it had a circular luminous shape with a halo type glow around it.
There was virtually no breeze. It seemed to be observing the fireworks, too. It continued to the north and turned reddish and slowly faded.
I am an artist and my wife is a librarian. We have both spent our entire life in the country and we are very familiar with the night skies and what planes etc. look like.
The sighting lasted maybe 45 seconds at most and in 64 years of observing the skies we have never seen anything like that in real life, only on television shows. This was definitely not a jet, satellite, conventional aircraft, or fireworks.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: Orange/Red Orb July 4th 2011
description:
Outside, observing small fireworks that neighbors were firing. Noticed reddish orange circular object that just looked different than airplanes, straight ahead, north of our home, moving south south west. My dad was a pilot and we watched planes from the time I was very young. 
As the object was passing to the west of us, I walked out to the road to get a better view as it moved southwest, thinking we would see blinking lights of an aircraft as it passed us, as many times the blinking lights are not viewable until they pass by at a different vantage point. There were no blinking lights from the three vantage points as it passed. There was some smoke in the air, so we also assumed that the smoke may have had an effect on the light we were seeing. 
The illuminated object remained the same size at all vantage points, about 2 times larger than the bright light of a lowflying aircraft. The light emanating had a shimmery effect. The color was a bright orange red! but again the object had a different shimmery effect, as if there was motion in the light, not clear cut points of light. 
The other witness described the object as "flying up" into the atmosphere. The light seemeded to fade…

summary: Two orange circle lights flying  side-by-side; one went straight up and the other went off into the distance and both disappeared.
description:
Flying from southwest to northeast over Middletown, CT, roughly 100 yards apart side-by-side for approximately 70 miles or so. 
One went straight up into the sky and disappeared 40,000-50,000 feet up and the other stayed on a straighter course and disappeared into the distance. 
They were both orange lighted circles roughly 1/10 of the size of a full moon. 
At first they appeared to be either helicopters or planes but there were other planes around which did not look the same as these circles.

summary: Solid individual orange-yellow lights flying from SW tracking directly into an intense lightning storm roughly 15 min apart..
description:
At around 20:00 CST, five witnesses at our location observed four single, pointed, very bright, orange-yellow lights spaced roughly 15 minutes apart and tracking NE from the SW horizon at a speed estimated to be at least that which would require jet propulsion. 
There were no strobes or other lights that could obviously associate this light with normal aviation operations. 
At the same time there was an intense storm moving in from the west that was displaying an incredible amount of mid-air and ground strike lightning and was creating near daylight conditions. 
As the source of light traveled, it made no sound and none was observed after it passed 90 degrees tangentially. 
There were periods when there was no thunder or wind and any engine noise should have been audible. The sky was clear above as we watched the front move in. 
The light, after roughly 100 seconds of travel, entered the clouds near the more intense lightning and disappeared. 
While moving between us and the clouds, there were flashes of lightning in the clouds that should have silhouetted any structure carrying the light and none was observed. 
The observers included 4 adults, two with some aviation background…

summary: Two slowly hovering amber lights.
description:
Two amber lights floating in the sky very slowly coming directly from the north then turned and went north west, then one disappeared and about 5 seconds later then other one did. 
This was no fireworks or plane or helicopter. At times it looked like they would come to almost a complete stand still. It was very weird.

summary: Orange spheres in formation
description:
I was in the middle of my town with 2 friends watching the fireworks from the park like every year and we seen orange sphere shaped craft almost in like a formation. 
They would get bright and fade till you couldnt see them and then flare back up.

summary: saw glowing orange ball of light and ghostly face
description:
on july 4th 2011 my family and i were watching fireworks in muncie in. and my fiance said something about a ufo and i turned the camera and saw a glowing orange ball of light. 
I couldn't see it on my view finder but i could see the light very clearly. it was to the right of the fireworks. 
i was afraid i wasn't recording it so i gave the camera to my fiance. it flew close to the fireworks and stopped. the object sit there for a minute and flew off to the left almost through the fireworks and behind some trees. we thought it was gone so we kept recording the fireworks. 
we wasn't sure we recorded the object until we viewed the sd card and we saw the craft and we also saw a ghostly, alien, almost demonic face come into view. it was only a face but it would open and close it's mouth and when it was facing us you could see glowing white eyes. we could not see the face while recording we were focused on the orange craft. but while watching the video we saw that face and didn't know what to think.

summary: Pitch black UFOs with red-pink light that faded
description:
This report summarizes the sighting of at least 3 unidentified flying objects on the east side of Cincinnati in Anderson Township. This happened on the evening of July 4, 2011, around 10 pm (time is approximate. I did not check the exact time when the sightings occurred). All three sightings occurred when there were fireworks going off in the sky, and later when the fireworks ceased, we had no more sightings.
The first sighting happened at approximately 10 pm (plus or minus 15 minutes). My son and his friends noticed a red/pinkish light in the distance to the southwest. It grew larger as it got closer and then they said the light just went out. That’s when I looked over to see what they were talking about. 
At that time, I could see the object, but it was pitch black. There were no lights on it at all, which ruled out commercial aircraft immediately. Also, the shape of it was irregular. 
From my angle, it looked to be somewhat triangle shaped, with the nose slightly rounded, but the “tail” was not straight as a triangle would be. The tail was rounded, or bulged out. It was almost heart-shaped, with the point being the nose. If flew due north at this point and my wife then saw it…

summary: 4th  of July ufo and a image of a ghostly alien face very disturbing
description: on the forth of July me and my girl friend and two kids and cousin was watching fireworks in Muncie Indiana when out of the south we noticed a orange light coming towards us we was recording the fireworks so i told my girl friend to try and catch it on tape we could see the craft right in front of us but couldn't see on the view screen of our camcorder so we wasn't sure if we got any thing or not. The craft seemed to stay out in front of us for a couple of minutes then flew off to the north. About 2 day's later i was telling a friend about what we saw and he has a nice computer so i said lets check the s d card out of the camera what i saw has had me spooked since as it turns out we did catch the craft and right below it you can see a ghostly image of a face and you can see it's glowing eye's just for a second and it's mouth open and shut it's very disturbing

summary: Orange yellow light in the sky that moved intermittently and stopped then slowly disappeared into night sky.
description:
Me along with two others were sitting on the side of a dirt road in greenbrier Arkansas. We were watching fireworks go off around us, and they were the only light that we could see since we're out in the country. All the sudden, we all see a orange yellow light in the sky closer than an airplane would normally be, but still a ways away. We all watched it for around a minute and a half; it moved for a couple seconds then slowed down almost to a stop and started up again. 
After about a minute, the light stopped, as if it noticed we were watching it, and it began to disappear into the night sky away from us. 
None of us had our phones, and we cant explain what we saw. It wasn't a firework because it moved steadily and on a straight path. And it couldn't have been an airplane or satellite because it stopped, then within about 5-6 seconds, it disappeared moving away from us. 
All we could do is say, "That was a UFO..." and drove home down the road.
Witness provides no contact information. PD

summary: orange fireball
description:
Myself and one other person were packing up after a firework show when we noticed an orange glowing orb in the distance. we joked it was an a firework that forgot to explode. 
there was no sound and no flashing lights like i would expect on any kind of aircraft. 
it was slowly moving horizontally north to south and appeared to almost stop after moving a good distance. 
it seemed to hover for a few seconds and then began moving straight up very quickly and disappeared.

summary: Red moving dot above Alabama on July 4th
description:
Me and my cousin were sitting outside watching and shooting fireworks when I noticed a red dot in the sky. 
It appeared to be moving at first in a straight line, but then proceeding to go backwards then it stopped completely. 
After watching it for a second I showed it to my cousin and watched it do the same. After turning my head for a brief second I looked back up and it was gone. 
Ten minutes later it reappeared and made the same awkward movements before disappearing. 
About an hour later I took her home on the other side of town, only to see the same object again, which my aunt also observed.

summary: There was a silent white light floating just above the trees.  Then it was gone.  Words can't discribe what we saw.
description:
My fianci who works for loss prevention, noticed a square light floating just above the trees. 
Once she said something to us it floated horizontally across the top of the trees when we saw it, it looked like a floating lantern. 
It went behind the trees. 
When we could see it again a few second later it was up hire and now Orange. 
Then it was gone.

summary: I can't belive i'm seeing this in hawaii.
description:
It came from the west side of oahu.It looked like a star at first,and then as it got closer the bright light dimmed. I saw a triangle shape craft with three red lights on the top of the triange. On the lower left there was one florecent green light, as it got closer.. The lights changed its location, and the three red lights that was on the top of the triangle was now on the lower right. 
Then as it came even closer like fifty feet away from my balecony wich is on the eight floor. As clear as day, I saw a space craft of none human nature. 
The fluorescent green light was like a lazer,on top of the craft. 
It was small in size the bottom of the triangle was five feet wide and it had a shinny black layer over the whole craft. The engine was soft but sounded like it had alot of power. 
It moved very slow and even hovered for about five to seven minutes. 
I watched it until it past my building.

summary: The object was moving abnormally, with orange rectangular lights around the sides of it that went dim and then very bright.
description:
When my girlfriend and i were out on her third floor apartment balcony watching fireworks on the horizon, we noticed a circular object fly into view, moving back and forth, then stopping, hovering, high above the interstate, then moving away and disappearing very quickly.
About 5 minutes later, it reappeared, moving back and forth, then hovering for approximately 10 minutes above the same part of the interstate before quickly disappearing into the sky. 
The object had rectangular orange lights around the sides of it, moving in a circular motion, that appeared to go dim and then very bright, almost looking like an orange star. 
We had a chance to examine it enough that there were no red blinking or white lights on it, as we normally see on a helicopter or airplane, it was flying much lower than airplanes we had previously seen flying over this area, and it wasn't moving in a way a helicopter would, as in circling an area.

summary: 5 orange lights. 2 moved together at same speed in an offset manner from west to east.  Then stopped and remained stationary.
description:
One light faded away. Then another light at high speed followed same flight path. A perfectly straight line, and way faster then any airplane. It stopped next to the other light. 
Two more lights followed in similar speed as first two the light stopped and then fade away in a flicker manner. 
This was visible over the Indian River Bay. 
There was no sound.

summary: Six persons witnessed six orange lights passing over Olmsted Falls, Ohio amid fireworks displays.
description:
At 21:50 on 7/4/11 I was leaving my father's home in Olmsted Falls, Ohio. After loading my car, we stood in his driveway and watched fireworks.
At 22:00 we were talking and turned to face northeast (two o' clock) in the direction of I-480 and North Olmsted Golf Club. Both of us saw a formation of six orange-colored, oval-shaped lights moving in line (from two o' clock to nine o' clock) toward our location.
I commented: "I don't think those are fireworks." My father was in the miliary and has flown aircraft. He stated: "They must be military transport choppers!" He added: "But it's not exactly safe conditions to be flying tonight." 
At 22:01 three neighbors from down the street had been watching fireworks (southwest) and approached, one woman asking my father (due to his knowledge of aircraft) "What kind of planes are those?" He told her he was uncertain.
The six orange lights flew in two wide triangular formations that stretched and contracted, narrowing as they passed over us. The lights were solid, exhibiting no blinking or pulsing. The lights made no sound, and my father remarked that "you can't hear the rotors." The lights paused at times, ascended and descended.
He asked me…

summary: these were not fireworks nor planes of which  I have seen many  -   they were things I had never  seen before --
description:
On the 4th of July, after seeing a few fireworks in the sky at 10:00pm, I looked to the eastern sky and saw a bright orange oval shaped object that was glowing was yellow inside - looked like a cat’s eye - it seem to float across the sky with no sound and no blinking lights -- just a glow - 
it gradually climbed higher and higher headed west til it was out of sight. 
In about 1 minute, another one came and flowed the same path and then a few minutes later , another one came following the exact same path as the two before. 
Then I saw a plane behind them - it had blinking color lights and a noise and I am sure was headed for nearby airport - I was not sure if it was following the objects or not -- I know was not fireworks - they were over and fireworks make a noise and fireworks dissipate into the sky they do not float and follow the exact path - the lights usually go in many different directions - these 3 objects I saw were all the same color , same size and followed the same path - More may have come by, but I grew a little afraid not knowing what they may do or if they knew I was taking pictures , so I went inside -- 
When searching the web, I learned many people saw the same…

summary: addition to Orange/Red Orb July 4th 2011
description:
Outside, observing small fireworks that neighbors were firing. Noticed reddish orange circular object that just looked different than airplanes, straight ahead, north of our home, moving south south west. 
My dad was a pilot and we watched planes from the time I was very young. 
As the object was passing to the west of us, I walked out to the road to get a better view as it moved southwest, thinking we would see blinking lights of an aircraft as it passed us, as many times the blinking lights are not viewable until they pass by at a different vantage point. There were no blinking lights from the three vantage points as it passed. 
There was some smoke in the air, so we also assumed that the smoke may have had an effect on the light we were seeing. 
The illuminated object remained the same size at all vantage points, about 2 times larger than the bright light of a lowflying aircraft. The light emanating had a shimmery effect. The color was a bright orange red but! again the object had a different shimmery effect, as if there was motion in the light, not clear cut points of light. The other witness described the object as "flying up" into the atmosphere. 
The light seemed to fade…

summary: Six Fireballs Spotted
description:
This evening, July 4, 2011, my family and I went outside to watch the fireworks being let off in the areas surrounding our neighborhood. As we watched the display, I noticed a nearly steady orange ball of light move across the sky, moving from the north to the south.
I initially thought it was a burning ember being blown away from the fireworks, but the light continued as the object moved almost the complete distance of the visible sky. As it moved past us and on further south, it flickered a few times and then went out.
We stayed outside for about half and hour, and during that time we saw a total of six of these objects moved across the sky in the same direction. They didn’t follow the same path as each other, but they all did move north to south, some of them extinguishing their light sooner than others. They were not all grouped together, but at one time there were two of them in the sky at the same time.
During this time, there were various airplanes flying overhead, so you could see the difference in their lights. These objects did not have the flashing lights that the airplanes did.

summary: 07/04/11 - University Place, WA - Spherical UFO with vertical running electric flames on the side of the craft
description:
On the evening of July 4th, 2011 my family and I were shooting fireworks legally at a park called: "Cirque/Bridgeport Park" in the city of University Place, WA. University Place is just south of Tacoma, WA.
It was 10 PM and dark. The lights in the park had just shut off, so I do know it was just about dead on 10PM.
There was no detectible wind at all. I was looking directly south, (I know this because the road entrance goes directly North-South.) I just verified this on a map so that I would be absolutely sure.
An object was heading due south running parallel to this entrance road. I immediately knew this was no aircraft. It had none of the required FAA lighting on the craft. 
I am an amateur astronomer and an aircraft enthusiast since I was young. I can tell you what a B-25, B17, Lancaster, 707, F-22 Raptor, etc. all look like. 
The first thing I noticed is that it was spherical in nature and had these flames surrounding it. I immediately thought, "bolide." No. 
As it was at my highest Zenith point to me, approximately 80 degrees over the western horizon it had no tail or flames at all trailing behind it. The flames were a dark reddish hue, hugging the craft on the sides and…

summary: moving horizontally then vertically, red/yellow orb, noiseless, able to go vertical at a quick speed and change positions quickly
description:
No time to think about switching settings on the camera to video; it was set for "twilight." I thought the pics were pretty good since it was black out and the thing was high. There were no "running lights" – just one big light that I thought was red and my husband thought was yellow so maybe it was changing. No noise either.
When I enlarge the 2nd pic on my camera it looks like there might have been 2 orbs??? The tail on the second pic (above and below) I think was from my moving the camera but not sure.
It was traveling horizontally and then shot up dissappearing for a short time and then reappearing in one location and then quickly in another and then dissappeard again and then I saw it in "space" (up very high) traveling horizontally at an extrememly rapid speed - faster than any airplane would go and then dissappeared totally.
It was difficult to check the characteristics below as I'm not sure on some of it. The trail in the picture could be from my movement, it was pretty high in order for me to really determine if there was a haze or aura, there appeared to be some beams in one picture at the lower left corner and as mentioned above I thought it was red and my husband…

summary: small fireball object in the sky that moved real slow, stopped  a few seconds and then was gone.
description:
My husband and I were on our back deck watching fire works. 
We looked to the right of us and noticed a small round object that looked like a small fire ball in the sky. The object was moving very slow, stopped for a few seconds and then was gone.

summary: 15 witnesses saw red lights at night over Auburn, Washington on 7/4/2011 - Not fireworks or lanterns.
description:
On the 4th of July, 2011, 15 people witnessed aprox. 12 different red/orange balls of light moving from east to west around 10:00 PM. The spheres continued to show up for about 45 minutes. Most of the witnesses are non-drinkers and were very alert, Thinking at first that they were 'Chinese lanterns', only a couple of pictures were attempted. While watching carefully, it was later decided that perhaps they were something unusual. A similar sighting was noted in 2009 of a single object on that Fourth of July, and it was also reported.
On the 4th this year, it was a warm night, little to no wind, fireworks going off everywhere. Some of us are familiar with various human made craft, and have seen 'chinese lanterns' in flight. This was purposeful and did not flicker or move in an erratic way. One group of five or six contained four spheres that were very close together in two sets of two. These broke apart and coninued to soar in a shape similar to the markings on dice - Like the '6' with one dot on the top missing. The sixth sphere winked out and lit up again as they traveled to the west. The shape became similar to the Big Dipper, but the movement was smooth and did not appear…

summary: 9 Red Lights that appeared in the night sky......
description:
There were nine (9) circular red lights that appeared traveling three (3) in row in a eastward direction . The first row of three were in straight line, side by side. The second row were in almost forming a L shape and the third row were traveling in a triangle pattern. 
As we watched and recorded the lights the first row of three appeared to be traveling further away before disappearing. While the second row began to change formation with two in the front and one trailing behind as if they were towing the third. The last row of lights also changed formation and appeared to go around and pass the second row and go further out into the sky then disappear. 
The second row continued at a steady but fast pace until they also went further into the night sky and disappeared.

summary: Orange Glowing Orb low across from SE to NW a Yearly 7/4 site.
description:
I have reported this in the past 2 years also. You can see my prior reports on same day at approx. same time. I think someone may be trying to create a hoax because it happens, so far, every 4th of July soon after fireworks (over past 3 years I’ve seen it).
It was approx 9:55 pm. An orange glowing orb glided slowly across the sky from the (approx) SW toward the NW for about 15 to 20 secs. I and a friend made sure to have binoculars handy this time and sure enough, the same sighting as in the past two years. We saw no other lights on the "craft" just a glowing orange ball.
The "Orange Glow" seemed to intensify and then dull a little a few times (like manipulating a dimmer) but for the most part was steady. Then, it just dimmed a bit and went abruptly totally out, while I was looking at it in my binoculars. 
But, I could not see anything of a "craft" once the glow disappeared. I looked with bare eyes then again with binoculars. And could not see a thing, nothing.. it was gone. Also, there were no other lights, none flashing or steady like a normal plane or helicopter etc.
Anyway, I hope u were able to have someone out here this year to try and catch it and find out what the heck…

summary: I saw a bright orange light rise up from near ground-level, hover a minute, and then ascend up into the sky.
description:
I was just thinking back to a year ago when a UFO was seen over Lincoln, and looking out my window, thinking that the only way I would see one tonight is if one was to appear right outside my window. 
At that moment, I saw a bright orange light ascending slowly in the sky, as if it just arose from near ground-level. 
I couldn't see it clearly through my bedroom window as it rose higher, so I dashed over to my porch, which offers only a small patch of clear sky to view. The object hovered right in the small patch of sky at about 15 degrees over the horizon, while fireworks were going off far below it. It was a bright orange light that was mostly steady but occasionally would pulsate. 
As I thought about going inside to get a camera, the object began to move away and within a minute or less, it rose up into the sky and disappeared. 
During the entire sighting, I could hear no sound from the object, even when I went out on my porch to view it.

summary: Sorry - false alarm; the bright orange light I saw was just a flare.
description:
Sorry, but what I reported earlier tonight (within 30 minutes of the event) was apparently just a very steady-burning flare. 
I saw another bright orange light later that evening and the second one had a visible parachute that took it drifting in the same general direction as the first light. 
The first event occurred at dusk and I guess the lighting was such that a parachute couldn't be seen at that time.

summary: Orange light hovering by power plant
description:
Was taking out the trash at work at about 9:45 pm. When I saw an orange light in the sky to the west of me above the tree line.
It hovered in place for about 30 seconds and then went straight down below the tree line without loosing any brightness at all.
A simiular object was sighted in the same area about 2 weeks before. This is also in the area of a nuclear power plant.

summary: Tonight myself and my son went to watch the 4th of July fireworks display at the local baseball stadium.  We parked on a street behind a grocery store nearby the stadium.
description:
While waiting for the fireworks to begin, my son pointed out an bright orange orb shaped light in the sky. The orb was larger than any star or light on an airplane I've ever seen. It appeared directly over top of the grocery store and seemed be still and not moving at all. I couldn't really tell how high up in the sky it was, but it appeared to be no higher than a low flying plane. It was not flashing or blinking in any way. It didn't change color or fade in and out, it was just a steady, bright orange colored light. 
It began moving very slowly toward us going from south-east to north-west. It made no sound as it moved. It also moved very smoothly in a straight line, not changing it's speed or jerking in any way. It moved approximately 200 feet in 3-4 minutes. 
While we were watching it, an airplane flew right by it going in a south-eastern direction. Almost immediately, after the plane passed the object, it turned to the north and seemed to just fade away. 
Other than myself and my son, two women, and several children were watching the object, but I didn't get their names.

summary: 3 more red crafts
description:
My husband and I earlier saw two red objects in the sky when we were out watching the fireworks from our hillside. I reported them immediately. 
We then went outside again and saw three more of the same. My husband is a pilot. These were not planes. 
They came from the north and he estimates they were flying 5,000 to 7,000 altitude. 
They all went to essentially the same area then descended vertically into the atmosphere. 
We watched the red lights to about 35,000 until we could not see them anymore.
We have amended the time above to reflect an evening sighting. PD

summary: 7 Adults Witness very large white/yellow glowing objects near the moon on July 4, 2011
description:
On July 4, 2011, at approximately 9:45 pm we were getting ready to watch fireworks, when I looked to the West toward the direction of the moon and saw 3 very large circular lights located to the right of the moon. The lights were much too large to be stars and they were extremely bright for 1-2 minutes and would then fade to nothing. 
The lights would then appear again about a minute later and would be as bright as when we originally witnessed them. They did appear to remain in the same general location in the sky, but they moved up and down slightly. There did not appear to be any sideways movement witnessed. We also did not see flashing colored lights as with an airplane or helicopter. 
These were bright yellow/white glowing objects. We do live near a Nation Guard Base, but the flight path is in the opposite direction and the aircraft flown from this base do not exhibit the behavior witnessed. 
There were 7 adults and 1 child that witnessed the lights and none of us could figure out what we were witnessing, except that they were not stars or aircraft. 
Three of the adults present were managers, two adults were skilled trade workers, and the other two adults were college students.

summary: Fireball / disc shaped craft over hummelstown / herhsey PA area
description:
Traveling down 39 toward Hershey Park on our way to see Fireworks for the 4th.
Literally hundreds of people along the highway ( some other people were looking up at this object, but did not get to talk to them) AS driving down the highway my three children, ages 12-9 spotted what appeared as a orange pulsating fireball like object flying slowly toward highway 39. Was orange with yellow aura around it.
At first I told my kids, its probably a firework or a plane. But I soon realized as it got closer, it was not burning out, was not making noise and was getting brighter and larger.
After a few minutes, it seemeed to be following the vehicle and flew overhead.
At that point my 12 year old daughter got very upset, started freaking out and saying. "Its a large circle with a orange light in the middle! It's hovering over the car! Its a UFO!" 
 At that point I stopped the car immediately into a parking lot. I looked up and the oject shut off its lights.
It appeared at first to have completely vanished until my 10 year old son and myself looked over at the treeline and saw the shadow of a craft hovering over the trees. IT was shaped like a layered cake. 
My son drew what looked like a…

summary: Fireball spotted over saint charles missouri
description:
I was waiting at the entrance of my neighborhood for my fiancee to pick me up at about 9:15 and I saw a ball of light that looked like a fireball. It hovered until 9:43 pm. 
When my fiancee pulled up I yelled for her to get out her I phone and record it. According to her phone, it was 9:43. 
We recorded the event on her camera. The ball of light was at least 5-10 miles away. 
My fiancee that does not believe in UFO's saw this fireball as did I. I asked her does that look like a helicopter to you and she said it doesnt look like a plane or helicopter. 
I have been looking at the nights sky every night since the June 3, 2011 sighting. This was not the red navigation lights that you see with the red, green. and white combination. This was like a ball of fire that hovered for atleast 25 minutes. 
It did not flash or flicker like helicopter lights it hovered and looked like a ball of fire. at about 9:40 pm, the ball of fire started moving very fast but my fiancee managed to record the event on her Iphone.

summary: fireball orange object hovers through my yard in meriden
description:
I watched a circular trianglar fireball orange object hover from the front of my yard through the woods to the back. it was no plane nor firework had no sound and hovered relatively low. 
I watched it for about 2 mins glide from the front of my home up through the back into the woods.

summary: Red Lights over Geneva Lakes area
description:
My girlfriend, who I will refer to as O, and I were leaving my Father's house and we spotted four bright red lights to the south floating in the sky above the Geneva Lakes area of Wisconsin (Lake Geneva, Elkhorn, Delavan, Williams Bay, Fontana, Walworth). 
At first O thought they were fireworks, it is the 4th of July after all, but as we continued to watch them we realized that there was NO WAY they were fireworks. They were a constant, bright red. They didn't flicker, they didn't blink or pulse. 
I ran into the house to grab my Father and his roommate to see, by the time we got outside there were 9 red lights in the sky. They weren't moving in any apparent formation. It is hard to tell how fast they were going since I am not sure how far away they were from us. But they were moving West at what appeared to be a slow pace (Slower than what commercial airlines or hospital hilos appear to be moving) 
As they moved West/Southwest they began to fade slowly, like a ! dimmer switch was being turned down. As the bulk of them (8) moved west/southwest and faded one broke away from the pack and began moving higher than the rest and started to fade in and out, same dimmer switch analogy.…

summary: Glowing round object hovered in sky going eastward from North Augusta/Edgefield area.
description:
We were observing fireworks in Merriweather School District Area off Martintown Road and thought at first it was a spark from there but then it kept moving east and seemed to continue with the same intensity of glow. 
It did not go out but went so far away it finally disappeared.
We assume and evening sighting, and have amended the time above, to reflect that fact. PD

summary: unidentified object fades from sight above Lake Chelan near Manson WA
description: On the evening of July 4, 2011, my granddaughter took these pictures. The first one had an object that was clearly not the crescent moon. She was facing to the west from the deck of our second story condo. She looked at the instant feedback on her Exilim Casio digital camera and noticed the white spot. She immediately took a follow up picture that showed something fading in the same location. She was simply taking a picture of the sky originally, not the object. The photo was taken outside so there is no window glare. There were no fireworks allowed on the resort so that should eliminate that possibility I blew these up on my computer and noticed something of unusual shape inside it. The second photo shows an object in that same position (6 seconds later) that appears to be fading. Her time on the camera setting is obviously off when right clicking preferences but notice the time lapse between them.

summary: Orange fireball over South Bay/L.A. county
description:
We were all outside when one of us spotted the object in the sky. It was traveling south east very slowly, then it stopped and it shrunk as if it flew into the horizon and completely disappeared.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: Another mysterious vehicle observed, Chicago fireworks display, July 4, 2011.
description:
On July 4th, 2011, we were watching the fireworks on our highly tuned 40 in. t.v. when we noticed that through the actual explosions, and much higher than the horizon seen ufo, was a slowly moving from the perspective of the viewing camera cigar shaped craft lighted on the front and rear, with a group of lights, possibly square shaped, and from camera view moving slowly to the left. This occurrence lasted during a display of what one could describe as flashes of sparkles, through which my wife and I could perceive this vehicle. 
I hesitated to inform the center because concurrently there was a search for a recent drowning victim by a helicopter, but upon reflection there would be little chance of such machine being that high and in reasonable distance from the explosions. 
I have been told by Mr. davenport to contact the T.V. stations to have them confirm what we saw.

summary: Crafts Watching Fireworks with enormous crowd below
description:
This happened on July 4th at Webster Lake in Northglenn, CO. The time was approximately 9:35pm MST. 
Family were at the lake with family watching the fireworks, and took a picture. The picture clearly shows fireworks and that chaos in the air, and then to the right, I would say about an inch on the cell phone picture itself is a very not normal looking thing, very bright with self-illuminating lights. 
I would like to show the picture and get some feedback on it, maybe someone else from the lake saw it too. Mother-in-law says the craft hoovering was accompanied by 2-3 more crafts like it. Hope this sparks some interest, especially with the crafts seen in Lafayette, CO, recently.

summary: Three people saw a "fireball ufo" at  2 different times.
description:
On July 4th of 2011, at about 9:30 pm, me and my great uncle had been launching fireworks for an hour when we decided it was time to finish up. We were on our way back to his truck when I spotted a red object with a flashing whitish-yellow light. the light wasn't flashing but had the looked as if on fire, but it was flying level. After flying for several miles in sight it faded into the sky.
When we got back to my house, I still had company. Me and my great uncle explained what we saw. After we finished my mother said that my great uncle's mom had said to her "I just saw the strangest thing. Well I swear I saw a ufo. 
My mother then told us that my great uncle's mom's description matched our's.

summary: Nothings tops off a firework show like ufos!
description:
In the middle of the show, while I was chilling with my girlfriend and her parents. 
Off the the right of the fireworks looking south 3 orange lights appeared out of no where. They stayed is a triangle formation very high in the sky and there was also a storm to the left coming into town if that might rule out anything. 
Planes usually have blinking lights and many lights, but this had one solid glow of orange and no sounds. 
I just figured the aliens were wondering what the hell is happening on earth with all the firework activity.

summary: Seen four orange balls following each other in a row rising higher and higher into the sky
description:
Good evening, 
Tonight we were viewing the fireworks from our backyard, looking west and from the south four orange like balls of fire came moving fairly quickly and then slowed down and followed each other (almost like they were on a rope) and hit a certain area in the sky and started to get higher and higher. We have folks in this area that fly their hovercrafts, but they make noise when they fly over during the day. I read that some people say, they have seen "Chinese Lanterns," and I am not sure what they mean exactly, except when I explained the four objects seemed they were on a rope.
This is the second time that I have seen this object, the first time was in January 2011, and me and one of my friend's heard a noise above us, and this big orange ball (like a loss hot air balloon) flew over us. 
This sighting was no noise and four individual objects. 
I actually cannot believe I am contacting anyone about this, but it was amazing and I wasn’t alone this time either. 
We are thinking it could be something the government is experimenting with so, I will be anguish to read tomorrow’s newspaper and see if anyone else had seen what we had seen this evening.
You ask for our…

summary: "Fireball" sighting south of Tacoma, Washington, lasted several minutes.
description:
About 9:30pm (I'm guessing on the time, it was not yet completely dark to the west when this started) on July 4th, 2011, I was in my backyard taking video of the fireworks going off in the neighborhood. 
I was panning back and forth as the aerials went off around me, but I wasn't looking through the lens; I had the LCD display turned out, but I was eyeballing for launches and then would turn the camera that way. 
To the SSE, I noticed a red glow in the sky, automatically thought some sort of firework in the distance, but it wasn't moving, it didn't explode, it just sort of hung there. I turned the camera toward it, but it wasn't bright enough to show up on the LCD display. Nevertheless, I did keep the camera trained on it for about a minute by lining up the top of the camera and the side of the camera. My eyesight is not the best, (I'm in my 50's) but it seemed to have at least two points, high and low, producing the red glow, although they were very close to each other, but the point is that it did seem to have some structure, it wasn't just a point of light, and although I had no idea of the distance between us, the diameter of the glow was about a tenth of the diameter of the…

summary: Object darted across the sky and would stop on a dime and dart in another direction
description:
On July 4th, ~9:30 pm, while watching a fireworks show in Madison, Alabama, my sister, my mother, I myself along with a few other people all noticed a moving object in the sky. It appeared to look like any other star in the sky, but this object darted, danced, and even went in circles.
I am not aware of any aircraft that could make such movements in the sky as this object did. We watched this object dart back and forth across the sky for over an hour. It was still darting and zig zagging around when I left to go home so for how long this object actually appeared I really do not know. I have never witnessed anything like this before.

summary: formation or fleet of UFOs, orange/red oval shape.
description: On July 4th 2011, at approximately 21:30pm, there were firewalls towards the east of my home (Pembroke Pines). My neighbors were also doing some firewalls, and I went out my home to watch them while walking my dog. Then I saw a formation of six (6) bright incandescent red/orange oval objects in the sky, to the east, traveling from north to south. The distance between each object was exactly the same, and there was not a noise from them. The traveling speed was constant. So, initially I thought a kind of balloons, perhaps attached between them, however I disregarded that explanation because of the constant speed, no noise, and the size of each object (bigger than a commercial airplane). I see frequently lot of planes due to the location of the two airports (MIA and FLL), and these objects were not airplanes. My neighbors saw them also, and they described them as something “bizarre”. I follow the object with my eyes all the way, until the horizon did not allo! w me to watch them anymore. However, after the six-object passed all the way in front of my sight, one minute after, another object, same shape and color started flying in the same spot the six other started minutes before,…

summary: red streak in photo 4th of july.
description:
I was taking pictures of fireworks and upon checking them on my laptop I noticed the red streak behind the firework going of. 
I found this a little odd and thought I would send it of to you guys for analysis. thank you.

summary: Orange glowing sphere over New Berlin Wisconsin
description:
We were going to the 4th of July festival and had just parked. 
We saw an orange/red sphere rising up slowly as if it were a helicopter and then hover. It seemed to almost be glowing, but the brightness was pulsating. While we were observing this a group of people behind us spotted it too. We were able to watch it for about a full minute when it zoomed off so fast that it disappeared within seconds. I would guess it was a few miles away.

summary: So around 9:30 PM on July 4 2011... my pregnant girlfriend and I saw a UFO while watching fireworks in the valley.
description:
For some reason I had looked behind me, and less than 100' and about 60' high was a "Black mechanical jellyfish looking thing about the size of a VW Bug. It was flat black, but appeared to have a very structured fluid like movement to it.
When we made initial eye contact with this craft, it made a shuddering movement, almost like it was surprised we had seen it. The craft continued its internal movements while it made its way over our heads and around again 100' away from us. It was at this point the girl that was with me and I finally looked at each other, we were too stunned to do so at first.
I then said, " Do you see that?" Girl said, "Yes, not what I was expecting." I said, "Nope." These are the exact words said.
The "mechanical jellyfish" then kind of "super glided" away at high speed... but not towards the sky, just farther away and down into the valley. The craft did not make a sound.
I did not believe in UFO s until this event. My girlfriend and I did not speak about this event at any point other than asking if we had actually seen this the next night, and once again around 2 years later after separated. We do not know what to think... 
The only thing we know is on that…

summary: Small red light in the sky, did not waver.
description:
A small red light was seen in the sky shortly after firework display. 
It did not move! It stayed in place for 10 mins, maybe more as I left before it faded. (It may still be out ther as I write.) 
It seemed to be three lights, then went down to one.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: Red Orbs in the sky above Lake Reba in Richmond, KY.
description:
We saw an red glowing object in the sky that hovered in the sky above Lake Reba next to the Richmond park. 
The object would appear then slowing disappear to reappear on the other side of the park. 
We watched it do this for about thirty minutes before it was fully dark out.

summary: The flying objects seem to appear and dissapear without leaving a trail in the long exposure photos.
description:
I took these photos on July 4th around 9:30 pm MDT from my home balcony. I used a Canon T2i digital camera (18 Meg) set at ISO 800 and for 10 second exposures. Each picture was taken 30 seconds apart. 
With those settings, any objects like airplanes, fireworks, an even helicopters would show a trail. Even the stars, if you zoom in, would show a small trail due to the earth rotation during 10 seconds of exposure.
The flying objects in the photos were pretty steady in their positions, except that they seem to appear and dissapear without leaving a trail. Notice the change from photos number 5 and 6, where quite a few objects appeared from the twighlight zone.
These objects were not visible with the naked eye. They showed up in my pictures due to the high sensitivity of the camera and the long exposure. The last three photos are just enlargerments of the first 3 (the originals). I promise there is no photoshop involved in this.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: Witnessed a floating  pulsating orange ball, that stopped glowing, flashed blue/white lights, glowed orange again, then went out.
description:
Me and my mother was at the firework show in lancaster ohio. 
About 30 minutes before the fire works start (around 9:30ish) Me and my mom saw this floating orange ball in the sky, the glowing of the orange ball was pulsating, 
we spotted it from a distance as it moved closer to us, still with the orange glow pulsating. we knew it had to have been moderately high in the air because the object kept going behind clouds that appeared to be very high in the sky, and you could still see the glow (Faintly) behind the clouds. It was moving in and out of the clouds. 
Witnesses beside us said it was a candle tied to a balloon, or a japanese lantern, which i started to think "oh yeah that makes sense" but, the orange ball continued to pulsate and then the orange ball started slowly dimming, which i thought was the candle going out due to lack of oxygen. 
The weird thing was though that as soon as the orange glow went out there was a bright blue flash immediately followed b! y a bright white flash, (and the flashes werent like the flash of a firework) the object disappeared for a minute, then the orange glow reappeared and continued to pulsate again for a few minutes. 
As it was approaching…

summary: My home is  located 20 miles north east of los Angeles I walked out of my house on 4th of July  to see if I was able to see any fireworks at 9:28 p.m,  so I saw my neighbor, and started talking…
Fleet of 11 color-flashing craft making formations in the night sky
description:
On 7/04/2011 I saw a formation of 11 unknown color-flashing silver craft slowly moving in the sky and making formations over the city of Redondo Beach.
I was coming home from the Redondo Beach breakwater, after having watched the city seaside fireworks show with my father, and as we were walking back to our bicycles to go home I saw the crafts suspended in the air and moving in ways inconceivable for fireworks, planes or balloons. A crowd of others around me were stopping, gasping and pointing to them.
When I first noticed the crafts, it seemed that 10 were already there, and I had looked in time to see one float vertically in the air from a low altitude and then suddenly stop to join the others. They were silver-colored craft that flashed colors of green, red, blue and yellow, like flashing strobes. The crafts never made a single sound, and moved silently all around each other independently. 
They had been up there for at least a minute after I started watching, because I was able to obtain pictures and a 00:00:45 video. After making their formations, each craft, one by one, faded away into the darkness and disappeared.
This is the single most dumbfounding event I have ever seen.…

summary: Three lights in Beecher, Illinois.
description:
Me and my husband and our three children were headed to see the Beecher fireworks. We were coming from indiana and following my parents in thier car, with my two brothers. We really close to turning right onto Dxie Highway. I dont know the street name, im not really familliar with Ill. 
As we were driving I was looking out the wpassenger window toward the west, and I noticed theses three orangish lights. I noticed they werent moving and were in a triangle pattern. just sitting there. They looked like steady light then later i thought they flashed. 
I cant be sure. we kept driving and i tried to get a picture. I took two pictures but by then one of the lights had faded off and only two were visible. It was wierd because it didnt just vanish it was it decided to turn off its self and it just faded away. the other two disappeared after i took the two pictures. we had pulled over by then. 
I have never seen anything like it, except in movies maybe. The picture were from a moving car so you can only just barely see the two lifghts above the tree line. They were above a field, but by the time I took the pictures, trees were in my way. 
Also, not sure if this is off worth mentioning, but…

summary: Two orange triangles moving simultaneously behind each other, then after 20/30 seconds, disappear on a clear stary night.
Single orange fireball that moved slowly East to West, stopped and slowly disappeared.
description:
We were sitting on the Chestnut Bridge in Rockford, IL waiting for the fireworks to start on July 4, 2011. The street lights had just come on (I believe it was around 21:20) when my daughter saw what appeared to be a single orange circular fireball. 
She nudged me and asked what it was. I had no idea. We watched it travel slowly from East to West, when it stopped moving and the light slowly faded and disappeared. There was no sound emitted from the object. 
We saw several people in the crowd look up at it, but no one offered any explanations.
I saw something that looked exactly the same on Saturday, July 2, on the lake at Apple Canyon, IL, waiting for their fireworks to begin which was also around 21:20. It had the same shape and color (circular and orange)and there was only 1. It moved slowly West to East. 
I watched it for a minute when I got distracted by someone and averted my eyes for only a moment. When I went to watch it some more, the object was gone.
I am not one of those people who believe in UFO’s, but thus far, no one has offered a reasonable explanation as to what the object was.
